punctuated:
成化十一年進士登科錄

玉音

成化十一年二月二十七日，禮部尚書臣鄒榦等於奉天門奏，為科舉事：會試天下舉人，取中三百名。本年三月初一日殿試，合請讀卷官及執事等官，少保、吏部尚書兼文淵閣大學士彭時等五十二員。其進士出身等第，恭依太祖高皇帝欽定資格：第一甲例取三名，第一名從六品，第二、第三名正七品，賜進士及第；第二甲從七品，賜進士出身；第三甲正八品，賜同進士出身。奉聖旨：「是。欽此。」

讀卷官

資德大夫、正治上卿、戶部尚書兼翰林院學士商輅〔乙丑進士〕。
資善大夫、禮部尚書兼翰林院學士萬安〔戊辰進士〕。
資善大夫、吏部尚書尹旻〔戊辰進士〕。
translation_en:
Record of the Metropolitan Graduates of the Eleventh Year of the Chenghua Era (1475)

Imperial Decree

On the twenty-seventh day of the second month of the eleventh year of the Chenghua era [April 2, 1475], Your Servant Zou Gan 鄒榦, Minister of Rites, and others memorialized at the Gate of Worshipping Heaven regarding the civil service examinations: In the Metropolitan Examination of provincial graduates (juren) from across the empire, three hundred candidates have been selected. For the Palace Examination to be held on the first day of the third month of this year [April 6, 1475], it is proper to request the appointment of Paper-reading Officials (dujuan guan) and various officiating functionaries, totaling fifty-two officials, including Peng Shi 彭時, Junior Guardian, Minister of Personnel, and concurrently Grand Secretary of the Hall of Literary Profundity. With respect to the status classifications of the metropolitan graduates (jinshi), we respectfully follow the qualifications imperially established by the Grand Progenitor, Emperor Gao [the Hongwu Emperor]: In the First Class (jia), three candidates are selected by precedent; the first-place candidate is accorded rank 6b, and the second- and third-place candidates are accorded rank 7a, all being conferred the title of Metropolitan Graduate with Honors (jinshi jidi). Those in the Second Class are accorded rank 7b and conferred the title of Metropolitan Graduate (jinshi chushen). Those in the Third Class are accorded rank 8a and conferred the title of Associate Metropolitan Graduate (tong jinshi chushen).

An Imperial Edict was received: "Approved. Respect this."

Paper-reading Officials

Shang Lu 商輅, Grand Master for Assisting Toward Virtue, Senior Worthy for Governance, Minister of Revenue, and concurrently Hanlin Academician (Metropolitan Graduate of the yichou year [1445]).

Wan An 萬安, Grand Master for Assisting Toward Goodness, Minister of Rites, and concurrently Hanlin Academician (Metropolitan Graduate of the wuchen year [1448]).

Yin Min 尹旻, Grand Master for Assisting Toward Goodness and Minister of Personnel (Metropolitan Graduate of the wuchen year [1448]).

translation_en:
Order of Imperial Honors
Eleventh Year of the Chenghua Reign (1475)
Early in the morning on the first day of the third month, the tribute scholars (gongshi) proceeded to the Inner Palace for the Palace Examination. His Majesty took his seat in the Hall of Heaven's Mandate (Fengtian dian) and personally bestowed the policy question.
Early in the morning on the third day of the third month, all civil and military officials attended in court dress in their respective ranks. On this day, the Embroidered-Uniform Guard (Jinyi wei) set out the imperial insignia along the Cinnabar Steps and within the Cinnabar Courtyard. His Majesty took his seat in the Hall of Heaven's Mandate, and officials of the Court of State Ceremonial (Honglu si) transmitted the imperial decree and called out the names on the roll. Officials of the Ministry of Rites (Libu) carried the yellow placard, led by drums and music, out through the Left Gate of Eternal Peace (Chang'an zuomen) to post it on display. Once this was completed, officials of Shuntian Prefecture (Shuntian fu) escorted the Principal Graduate (zhuangyuan) back to his residence with a ceremonial parasol and retinue.
On the fourth day of the third month, …

translation_en:
…[On the fourth day of the third month,] an imperial banquet was bestowed at the Ministry of Rites. When the banquet ended, they proceeded to the Court of State Ceremonial to rehearse the court rituals.
On the fifth day of the third month, the Principal Graduate (zhuangyuan) was bestowed court dress, cap, and belt, and the metropolitan graduates (jinshi) were bestowed paper money (baochao).
On the sixth day of the third month, the Principal Graduate led all the metropolitan graduates in submitting a memorial to express gratitude for imperial grace.
On the seventh day of the third month, the Principal Graduate led all the metropolitan graduates to the Temple of the Former Teacher Confucius to perform the ritual offering of vegetables (shicai). The Ministry of Rites submitted a memorial requesting that the Ministry of Works be ordered to erect a stone stele at the Directorate of Education inscribed with their names.

Xie Qian 謝遷: Registered as a civilian household in Yuyao County, Shaoxing Prefecture, Zhejiang; a County Student specializing in the Record of Rites (Liji); courtesy name Yuqiao 于喬; second in seniority among brothers; aged twenty-seven, born on the twenty-eighth day of the twelfth month. His great-grandfather is Yuanguang 原廣; his grandfather is Ying 瑩 (former Office Manager in a Provincial Administration Commission); his father is En 恩, and his mother is née Zou 鄒. Both his parents and grandparents are living. His younger brothers are Xuan 選, Di 迪, and Chi 遲; he is married to née Xu 徐. He placed first in the Zhejiang Provincial Examination and third in the Metropolitan Examination.

Liu Jian 劉戩: Registered as a civilian household in Anfu County, Ji'an Prefecture, Jiangxi; a National University Student specializing in the Classic of Changes (Yijing); courtesy name Jingyuan 景元; first in seniority among brothers; aged forty-one, born on the fifteenth day of the eleventh month. His great-grandfather is Nengkuan 能寬; his grandfather is Donghui 東匯; his father is Piyan 丕嚴, and his mother is née Zhao 趙. Both of his parents are living. His younger brothers are Jian 戬 [?], Jingke 景恪, and Jinglong 景隆; he is married to née Hu 胡. He placed sixtieth in the Jiangxi Provincial Examination and fifteenth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Wang Ao 王鏊: Registered as a civilian household in Wu County, Suzhou Prefecture, Southern Metropolitan Area (Zhili); a Prefectural Student specializing in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); courtesy name Jizhi 濟之; second in seniority among brothers; aged twenty-six, born on the seventeenth day of the eighth month. His great-grandfather is Boying 伯瑛; his grandfather is Weidao 惟道; his father is Chaoyong 朝用 (District Magistrate), and his mother is née Ye 葉. Both his parents and grandparents are living. His elder brother is Ming 銘, and his younger brother is Lian 鍊; he is married to née Wu 吳. He placed first in the Yingtian Prefectural Provincial Examination and first in the Metropolitan Examination.

金楷〔貫直隸蘇州府嘉定縣軍籍，縣學生，治《書經》，字式之，行一，年二十八，十二月初八日生〕。曾祖仲禮；祖毓；父洪〔教諭〕；母陸氏。具慶下。弟格、相。娶曹氏。應天府鄉試第二十九名，會試第二名。

王沂〔貫直隸常州府武進縣軍籍，縣學增廣生，治《春秋》，字希曾，行二，年三十三，十一月十九日生〕。曾祖友諒〔知府〕；祖守正〔兵部主事，贈左庶子兼侍講〕；父俁〔南京國子監祭酒〕；母吳氏〔贈恭人〕；繼母孫氏〔封恭人〕。具慶下。兄澄；弟濟、清、潔、淇、浩、洛、深。娶楊氏。應天府鄉試第三十一名，會試第一百二十名。

郭定〔貫山西澤州高平縣官籍，國子生，治《詩經》，字靜之，行四，年三十一，八月十一日生〕。曾祖景昭；祖欽〔監察御史〕；父質〔知州〕；前母倪氏；母王氏。慈侍下。兄寧、宗〔知縣〕、宥；弟寂、完、宏、騫、拱宸、拱宿。娶邢氏，繼娶崔氏。山西鄉試第十二名，會試第二百六十六名。

楊茂元〔貫浙江寧波府鄞縣民籍，國子生，治《易經》，字志仁，行一，年二十六，十一月二十二日生〕。曾祖九疇；祖自懲〔贈侍讀學士兼編修〕；父守陳〔侍講學士〕；母丁氏〔封孺人〕。具慶下。弟茂貞、茂義、茂智、茂忠。娶錢氏。浙江鄉試第五名，會試第四名。
translation_en:
Jin Kai 金楷: Registered as of a military household in Jiading County, Suzhou Prefecture, Zhili; a County Student specializing in the Book of Documents (Shujing); courtesy name Shizhi, first in seniority among his brothers, aged twenty-eight, born on the eighth day of the twelfth month. His great-grandfather was Zhongli; his grandfather was Yu; his father is Hong (County Director of Studies); his mother is Lady Lu. Both parents are living. His younger brothers are Ge and Xiang. He married Lady Cao. He placed twenty-ninth in the Yingtian Prefectural Provincial Examination and second in the Metropolitan Examination.

Wang Yi 王沂: Registered as of a military household in Wujin County, Changzhou Prefecture, Zhili; an Added County Student specializing in the Spring and Autumn Annals (Chunqiu); courtesy name Xizeng, second in seniority among his brothers, aged thirty-three, born on the nineteenth day of the eleventh month. His great-grandfather was Youliang (Prefect); his grandfather was Shouzheng (Secretary in the Ministry of War, posthumously honoured as Left Mentor combined with Expositor-in-waiting); his father is Yu (Chancellor of the Nanjing Directorate of Education); his mother was Lady Wu (posthumously honoured as Lady of Respect); his stepmother is Lady Sun (invested as Lady of Respect). Both his father and stepmother are living. His elder brother is Cheng; his younger brothers are Ji, Qing, Jie, Qi, Hao, Luo, and Shen. He married Lady Yang. He placed thirty-first in the Yingtian Prefectural Provincial Examination and one hundred twentieth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Guo Ding 郭定: Registered as of an official household in Gaoping County, Zezhou, Shanxi; a National University Student specializing in the Book of Odes (Shijing); courtesy name Jingzhi, fourth in seniority among his brothers, aged thirty-one, born on the eleventh day of the eighth month. His great-grandfather was Jingzhao; his grandfather was Qin (Investigating Censor); his father was Zhi (Department Magistrate); his father's former wife was Lady Ni; his mother is Lady Wang. His mother is living. His elder brothers are Ning, Zong (County Magistrate), and You; his younger brothers are Ji, Wan, Hong, Qian, Gongchen, and Gongsu. He married Lady Xing, and subsequently married Lady Cui. He placed twelfth in the Shanxi Provincial Examination and two hundred sixty-sixth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Yang Maoyuan 楊茂元: Registered as of a commoner household in Yin County, Ningbo Prefecture, Zhejiang; a National University Student specializing in the Book of Changes (Yijing); courtesy name Zhiren, first in seniority among his brothers, aged twenty-six, born on the twenty-second day of the eleventh month. His great-grandfather was Jiuchou; his grandfather was Zicheng (posthumously honoured as Academician Reader-in-waiting combined with Junior Compiler); his father is Shouchen (Academician Expositor-in-waiting); his mother is Lady Ding (invested as Child Nurturer). Both parents are living. His younger brothers are Maozhen, Maoyi, Maozhi, and Maozhong. He married Lady Qian. He placed fifth in the Zhejiang Provincial Examination and fourth in the Metropolitan Examination.

楊仕偉〔貫福建建寧府建安縣官籍，國子生，治《春秋》，字景竒，行八，年三十九，八月二十一日生〕。曾祖伯成〔贈榮禄大夫、少傅、工部尚書兼大學士〕；祖榮〔少師，贈特進光禄大夫、左柱國、太師，謚文敏〕；父恭〔尚寶司少卿〕；嫡母黄氏〔封太淑人〕；生母郭氏。永感下。兄泰〔指揮同知〕、儼、俊〔中書舍人〕、倫、儉、佶〔太學生〕、倓；弟儔、侗。娶朱氏。福建鄉試第二十五名，會試第五名。

劉忠〔貫四川敘州府南溪縣民籍，縣學生，治《易經》，字臣節，行三，年三十五，十一月初一日生〕。曾祖永壽〔同知〕；祖琬；父恂〔教授〕；前母郭氏、王氏、熊氏；母張氏。永感下。兄廣、本、文、廓；弟信〔同科進士〕。娶鄧氏。四川鄉試第二名，會試第六名。

吳倬〔貫浙江嚴州府淳安縣民籍，國子生，治《春秋》，字克大，行六，年三十六，十二月二十四日生〕。曾祖希賢；祖昶；父士才；母邵氏。具慶下。兄仁、偉、保、俊、倫；弟仕、佐。娶程氏。浙江鄉試第七十九名，會試第二百二十一名。

translation_en:
Yang Shiwei 楊仕偉 [registered in Jian'an County, Jianning Prefecture, Fujian, under official household status; Student of the Directorate of Education; specialized in the Spring and Autumn Annals (Chunqiu); courtesy name Jingqi; eighth in seniority among his brothers; aged thirty-nine; born on the twenty-first day of the eighth month]. His great-grandfather was Yang Bocheng [posthumously conferred the titles of Grand Master for Glorious Happiness, Junior Tutor, and Minister of Works concurrently serving as Grand Secretary]; his grandfather was Yang Rong [Junior Preceptor, posthumously conferred the titles of Specially Advanced Grand Master for Splendid Happiness, Left Pillar of State, and Grand Preceptor, with the posthumous name Wenmin]; his father was Yang Gong [Vice Minister of the Seal Office]; his legal mother was Lady Huang [titled Grand Lady of Virtue]; and his birth mother was Lady Guo. Both of his parents are deceased. His elder brothers are Yang Tai [Vice Commander], Yang Yan, Yang Jun [Drafter in the Central Drafting Office], Yang Lun, Yang Jian, Yang Ji [Student of the Directorate of Education], and Yang Tan; his younger brothers are Yang Chou and Yang Tong. He married Lady Zhu. He placed twenty-fifth in the Fujian Provincial Examination and fifth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Liu Zhong 劉忠 [registered in Nanxi County, Xuzhou Prefecture, Sichuan, under civilian household status; County Student; specialized in the Classic of Changes (Yijing); courtesy name Chenjie; third in seniority among his brothers; aged thirty-five; born on the first day of the eleventh month]. His great-grandfather was Liu Yongshou [Vice Prefect]; his grandfather was Liu Wan; his father was Liu Xun [Prefectural Instructor]; his father's former wives were Lady Guo, Lady Wang, and Lady Xiong; and his mother was Lady Zhang. Both of his parents are deceased. His elder brothers are Liu Guang, Liu Ben, Liu Wen, and Liu Kuo; his younger brother is Liu Xin [metropolitan graduate (jinshi) of the same examination class]. He married Lady Deng. He placed second in the Sichuan Provincial Examination and sixth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Wu Zhuo 吳倬 [registered in Chun'an County, Yanzhou Prefecture, Zhejiang, under civilian household status; Student of the Directorate of Education; specialized in the Spring and Autumn Annals (Chunqiu); courtesy name Keda; sixth in seniority among his brothers; aged thirty-six; born on the twenty-fourth day of the twelfth month]. His great-grandfather was Wu Xixian; his grandfather was Wu Chang; his father is Wu Shicai; and his mother is Lady Shao. Both of his parents are living. His elder brothers are Wu Ren, Wu Wei, Wu Bao, Wu Jun, and Wu Lun; his younger brothers are Wu Shi and Wu Zuo. He married Lady Cheng. He placed seventy-ninth in the Zhejiang Provincial Examination and two hundred twenty-first in the Metropolitan Examination.

Zhang Rui 張銳 [registered in Qinzhou, Gongchang Prefecture, Shaanxi, under military household status; Student of the Directorate of Education; specialized in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); courtesy name Yizhi; first in seniority among his brothers; aged thirty-seven; born on the twenty-second day of the fifth month]. His great-grandfather was Zhang Ming [Battalion Commander]; his grandfather was Zhang Zhongxian [Platoon Commander]; his father was Zhang Min [Record Keeper in a Provincial Administration Commission]; and his mother was Lady Wang. Both of his parents are deceased. His younger brother is Zhang Duo. He married Lady Li. He placed twenty-second in the Shaanxi Provincial Examination and one hundred eighty-sixth in the Metropolitan Examination.

translation_en:
Hua Shan 華山 (registered in a civilian household of Wuxi County, Changzhou Prefecture, Southern Metropolitan Area [Zhili]; a Directorate Student, specializing in the Classic of Changes [Yijing]; courtesy name Renfu, first in seniority among his brothers; aged twenty-eight, born on the first day of the first lunar month). His great-grandfather was Hua Xueze; his grandfather was Hua Han; his father is Hua Jifang; his mother was née Xia, and his stepmothers are née Jiang and née Lou. Both parents are living (father and stepmother). He married née Wang, and was subsequently betrothed to née Shi. He placed 64th in the Yingtian Prefectural Provincial Examination and 96th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Wang Fu 王傅 (registered in a civilian household of Zhouzhi County, Xi'an Prefecture, Shaanxi; a Directorate Student, specializing in the Classic of History [Shujing]; courtesy name Liangbi, third in seniority among his brothers; aged twenty-seven, born on the fourth day of the second lunar month). His great-grandfather was Wang Kezhong; his grandfather was Wang Rong (posthumously titled Prefect); his father is Wang Xi (Prefect); his mother is née Gong (invested as Mistress of Respect [Gongren]). Both parents are living. His elder brother is Wang Yi, and his younger brother is Wang Ji. He married née Zhao. He placed 47th in the Shaanxi Provincial Examination and 158th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Yang Sheng 仰昇 (registered in a civilian household of Wuwei Subprefecture, Luzhou Prefecture, Southern Metropolitan Area [Zhili]; a Directorate Student, specializing in the Classic of Poetry [Shijing]; courtesy name Jinqing, sixth in seniority among his brothers; aged forty-one, born on the twenty-first day of the third lunar month). His great-grandfather was Yang Huacan; his grandfather was Yang Xingfu; his father was Yang Cheng (Office Manager of a Branch Secretariat [?]); his mother was née Lu. Both parents are deceased. His elder brother is Yang Min. He married née Chen. He placed 15th in the Yingtian Prefectural Provincial Examination and 57th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Chen Mo 陳謨 (registered in a civilian household of Jiande County, Chizhou Prefecture, Southern Metropolitan Area [Zhili]; a County Student, specializing in the Classic of Poetry [Shijing]; courtesy name Jiayou, second in seniority among his brothers; aged thirty-four, born on the fourth day of the sixth lunar month). His great-grandfather was Chen Zhen (Supervising Secretary); his grandfather was Chen Gong (Instructor); his father is Chen Guangdao; his mother is née Guo. Both parents are living. His elder brother is Chen Gang, and his younger brothers are Chen Jing, Chen Lun, and Chen Xiqiao. He married née Zheng. He placed 50th in the Yingtian Prefectural Provincial Examination and 283rd in the Metropolitan Examination.

程廷珙〔貫江西饒州府浮梁縣民籍，縣學增廣生，治《詩經》，字獻之，行一，年三十三，八月初二日生〕。曾祖子政，祖存禮，父仕傑，母洪氏。嚴侍下。弟廷璨、廷琰、廷珊。娶甯氏。江西鄉試第七十一名，會試第一百七十六名。

吳欽〔貫浙江仁和縣人，順天府大興縣匠籍，國子生，治《易經》，字禹鄰，行六，年三十，九月十一日生〕。曾祖均實，祖朝宗，父本，母任氏。慈侍下。兄銘、鑑、鍾、鎮、鐸、鈺，弟镗。娶金氏，繼娶陳氏。順天府鄉試第三十七名，會試第五十一名。

彭經〔貫四川重慶府長壽縣軍籍，國子生，治《詩經》，字載道，行三，年三十七，十一月十八日生〕。曾祖誠〔府同知〕，祖添爵，父思明〔吏目〕，嫡母李氏，生母余氏。永感下。兄縉、紳。娶何氏。四川鄉試第六十三名，會試第三十九名。

馬中錫〔貫直隸河間府景州故城縣民籍，縣學生，治《易經》，字添祿，行二，年三十，三月十六日生〕。曾祖從周〔驛丞〕，祖顯，父偉〔知縣，贈奉直大夫〕，前母李氏，母姚氏，繼母朱氏。具慶下。兄恒、泰、驄〔戶部員外郎〕，弟元吉、驥、昇。娶吳氏。順天府鄉試第一名，會試第二十四名。
translation_en:
Cheng Tinggong 程廷珙 (courtesy name Xianzhi 獻之, first in generational order, aged thirty-three, born on the second day of the eighth month) was registered in a civilian household of Fuliang County, Raozhou Prefecture, Jiangxi, and was anAdded Student of the county school specializing in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing). His great-grandfather was Cheng Zizheng, his grandfather was Cheng Cunli, his father was Cheng Shijie, and his mother was née Hong. His father is living and his mother is deceased. His younger brothers are Tingcan, Tingyan, and Tingshan, and he is married to a woman née Ning. He placed 71st in the Jiangxi Provincial Examination and 176th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Wu Qin 吳欽 (courtesy name Yulin 禹鄰, sixth in generational order, aged thirty, born on the eleventh day of the ninth month) was a native of Renhe County, Zhejiang, registered in an artisan household of Daxing County, Shuntian Prefecture, and was a National University Student specializing in the Classic of Changes (Yijing). His great-grandfather was Wu Junshi, his grandfather was Wu Chaozong, his father was Wu Ben, and his mother was née Ren. His mother is living and his father is deceased. His elder brothers are Ming, Jian, Zhong, Zhen, Duo, and Yu, and his younger brother is Tang. He was married to a woman née Jin, and remarried to a woman née Chen. He placed 37th in the Shuntian Provincial Examination and 51st in the Metropolitan Examination.

Peng Jing 彭經 (courtesy name Zaidao 載道, third in generational order, aged thirty-seven, born on the eighteenth day of the eleventh month) was registered in a military household of Changshou County, Chongqing Prefecture, Sichuan, and was a National University Student specializing in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing). His great-grandfather was Peng Cheng (Prefectural Vice Prefect), his grandfather was Peng Tianjue, his father was Peng Siming (Chief of Police), his legal mother was née Li, and his birth mother was née Yu. Both of his parents are deceased. His elder brothers are Jin and Shen, and he is married to a woman née He. He placed 63rd in the Sichuan Provincial Examination and 39th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Ma Zhongxi 馬中錫 (courtesy name Tianlu 添祿, second in generational order, aged thirty, born on the sixteenth day of the third month) was registered in a civilian household of Gucheng County, Jingzhou Department, Hejian Prefecture, Zhili, and was a County Student specializing in the Classic of Changes (Yijing). His great-grandfather was Ma Congzhou (Postal Relay Station Master), his grandfather was Ma Xian, his father was Ma Wei (District Magistrate, posthumously honoured as Grand Master for Fostering Uprightness), his father's first wife was née Li, his mother was née Yao, and his stepmother was née Zhu. Both parents are living (father and stepmother). His elder brothers are Heng, Tai, and Cong (Vice Director in the Ministry of Revenue), and his younger brothers are Yuanji, Ji, and Sheng. He is married to a woman née Wu. He placed 1st in the Shuntian Provincial Examination and 24th in the Metropolitan Examination.

translation_en:
Zheng Zhong 鄭重 [native of Cixi County, Ningbo Prefecture, Zhejiang, registered in a military salt-producer household; Student of the Directorate of Education; specialized in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); courtesy name Benhong; fifth in seniority; aged thirty-six, born on the twenty-third day of the ninth month]. His great-grandfather was Zheng Zizhang 子璋; his grandfather was Zheng Dexin 德馨 [Supervisor]; his father is Zheng Long 鑨; and his mother is née Zhang 張氏. Both his parents are living. His younger brothers are Zheng Rang 壤, Zheng Pei 培 [Public-spirited Official], Zheng Yu 玉, Zheng Zhou 周, Zheng Gui 圭, Zheng Chao 超, Zheng Shen 深, Zheng Ji 濟, Zheng Qi 起, Zheng Pang 滂, and Zheng Bao 寳. He married née Zhang 張氏. He placed sixth in the Zhejiang Provincial Examination and twenty-fifth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Wang Cong 王鏓 [native of Cixi County, Ningbo Prefecture, Zhejiang, registered in a military household; Student of the Directorate of Education; specialized in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); courtesy name Wenyao; forty-sixth in seniority; aged thirty-four, born on the twenty-first day of the sixth month]. His great-grandfather was Wang Huan 桓 [District Magistrate, posthumously granted the title of Right Censor-in-chief concurrently Minister of the Court of Judicial Review]; his grandfather was Wang Lin 廩 [District Magistrate, posthumously granted the title of Right Censor-in-chief concurrently Minister of the Court of Judicial Review]; his father was Wang Ding 鼎 [Assistant Surveillance Commissioner]; his father's former wife was née Zhang 張氏 [posthumously granted the title of Child Nurturer]; and his mother was née Zhao 趙氏 [invested as Child Nurturer]. Both his parents are deceased. His elder brothers are Wang Duo 鐸, Wang Hao 鎬, Wang Yao 鑰 [Investigating Censor], Wang Lian 鍊, and Wang Jin 錦; his younger brothers are Wang Mo 鏌, Wang Wu 鋘, Wang Rui 銳, Wang Xiao 銷, and Wang Xuan 鉉. He married née Ying 應氏. He placed twentieth in the Zhejiang Provincial Examination and two hundred twenty-fourth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Wu Ximin 伍希閔 [native of Anfu County, Ji'an Prefecture, Jiangxi, registered in a commoner household; Student of the Directorate of Education; specialized in the Spring and Autumn Annals (Chunqiu); courtesy name Zhongxiao; second in seniority; aged thirty-nine, born on the twenty-sixth day of the ninth month]. His great-grandfather was Wu Shujing 述經; his grandfather was Wu Mian 冕 [District Magistrate, posthumously granted the title of Investigating Censor]; his father was Wu Ji 驥 [Investigating Censor]; his mother was née Peng 彭氏 [posthumously granted the title of Child Nurturer]; and his stepmother is née Liu 劉氏. His stepmother is living. His elder brother is Wu Xiyuan 希淵 [Director of a Bureau in the Ministry of Justice]; his younger brothers are Wu Xixian 希憲, Wu Xidan 希旦, Wu Xiran 希冉, Wu Xirong 希容, Wu Xiyu 希魚, and Wu Xiqi 希齊. He married née Wang 王氏. He placed forty-fifth in the Jiangxi Provincial Examination and thirty-fourth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Lei Shizhan 雷士旃 [native of Jian'an County, Jianning Prefecture, Fujian, registered in a commoner household; Prefectural Student; specialized in the Classic of Changes (Yijing); courtesy name Yuanfang; second in seniority; aged thirty, born on the twenty-sixth day of the sixth month]. His great-grandfather was Lei Jing 境; his grandfather was Lei Zi 鎡; his father is Lei Jiang 江; and his mother is née Wei 魏氏. Both his parents are living. His elder brother is Lei Chun 椿; his younger brothers are Lei Ji 楫 and Lei Qiao 橋. He married née Zhu 朱氏. He placed twenty-fifth in the Fujian Provincial Examination and two hundred second in the Metropolitan Examination.

translation_en:
Tong Chao 童潮 is a native of Cixi County, Ningbo Prefecture, Zhejiang, registered under a civilian household. A County Student specializing in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing), his courtesy name is Xinzhi, he is the sixth among his brothers, and he is thirty-nine sui, born on the third day of the third month. His great-grandfather was Tong Deji, his grandfather was Tong Shouli, his father was Tong Daji, and his mother was Lady Feng. Both of his parents are deceased. His elder brothers are Tong Shan, Tong Hai, Tong Tuan, and Tong Huai. He married Lady Zhang. He placed fourth in the Zhejiang Provincial Examination and 166th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Fan Ji 范吉 is a native of Tiantai County, Taizhou Prefecture, Zhejiang, registered under a civilian household. A Directorate Student (guozisheng) specializing in the Classic of Poetry, his courtesy name is Yizhen, he is the first among his brothers, and he is thirty-two sui, born on the eighteenth day of the intercalary seventh month. His great-grandfather was Fan Qizong (posthumously honored as Left Administration Commissioner of Guizhou), his grandfather was Fan Shixiang, his father is Fan Cunru, and his mother is Lady Chen. Both of his parents are living. His younger brothers are Fan Ze, Fan Lian, and Fan Si. He married Lady Chen. He placed third in the Zhejiang Provincial Examination and eighth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Chen Xiang 陳相 is a native of Taizhou Subprefecture, Yangzhou Prefecture, Southern Metropolitan Area (Zhili), registered under a military household. A Directorate Student specializing in the Classic of Poetry, his courtesy name is Zilin, he is the third among his brothers, and he is thirty-two sui, born on the twenty-first day of the ninth month. His great-grandfather was Chen Xing, his grandfather was Chen Xin, his father was Chen Lu (Assistant Instructor), and his mother was Lady Wang. Both of his parents are deceased. His elder brothers are Chen Ji and Chen Wei; his younger brothers are Chen Xu, Chen Zuo, Chen Zhen, Chen Yi, Chen Xuan, Chen Lan, Chen Xiang, and Chen Jing. He married Lady He. He placed 109th in the Yingtian Prefecture Provincial Examination and 238th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Zuo You 左悠 is a native of Nancheng County, Jianchang Prefecture, Jiangxi, registered under a civilian household. A Directorate Student specializing in the Spring and Autumn Annals (Chunqiu), his courtesy name is Shangyuan, he is the eighth among his brothers, and he is twenty-nine sui, born on the tenth day of the eleventh month. His great-grandfather was Zuo Qian (posthumously honored as Investigating Censor), his grandfather was Zuo Shijie, his father is Zuo Shiliang, his father's former wife was Lady Shi, and his mother is Lady Rao. Both of his parents are living. His elder brothers are Zuo Shangxun, Zuo Shangwen, and Zuo Dang [?]; his younger brother is Zuo Shangyi. He married Lady Huang. He placed eighteenth in the Jiangxi Provincial Examination and 151st in the Metropolitan Examination.

translation_en:
Sun Yu 孫裕 [registered under an official household in Kunshan County, Suzhou Prefecture, Southern Metropolitan Area (Zhili); an added student of the county school; specialized in the Classic of Changes (Yijing); courtesy name Dehong; first in his generation; age thirty-one, born on the thirtieth day of the seventh month]. His great-grandfather was Sun Xiang; his grandfather was Sun Gongwu [District Magistrate, enfeoffed as Director of a Bureau in the Ministry of Justice]; his father is Sun Qiong [Director of a Bureau in the Ministry of Justice]; and his mother is née Yan [invested as Lady of Suitability (Yiren)]. Both his parents and grandparents are living. His younger brothers are Sun Li, Sun Zhen, and Sun You. He married née Zhou. He placed sixty-ninth in the Yingtian Prefectural Provincial Examination and two hundred sixty-second in the Metropolitan Examination.

Ye Sheng 葉盛 [registered under a civilian household in Lanxi County, Jinhua Prefecture, Zhejiang; a student of the Directorate of Education; specialized in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); courtesy name Changbo; first in his generation; age forty-one, born on the twelfth day of the twelfth month]. His great-grandfather was Ye Zong; his grandfather was Ye Lian; his father is Ye Zhang; and his mother is née Shen. Both his parents and grandparents are living. His younger brothers are Ye Zha, Ye Quan, Ye Duo, Ye Dun, Ye Lu, and Ye Yong. He married née Wang. He placed fifty-third in the Zhejiang Provincial Examination and one hundred nineteenth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Chen Zhen 陳珍 [a native of Qingzhou Prefecture, Shandong, registered under a military banner household in the Yizhou Guard of Liaodong; a student of the guard school; specialized in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); courtesy name Tinggui; first in his generation; age thirty-nine, born on the twenty-sixth day of the first month]. His great-grandfather was Chen Zhong; his grandfather was Chen Qi; his father is Chen Sheng [Platoon Commander]; his mother was née Dong; and his stepmother is née Fang. His father and stepmother are both living. His younger brothers are Chen Xuan and Chen Zhang. He married née Wang. He placed first in the Shandong Provincial Examination and sixty-third in the Metropolitan Examination.

Yuan Shouzhi 元守直 [registered under a civilian household in Tangyin County, Zhangde Prefecture, Henan; a student of the county school; specialized in the Classic of Documents (Shujing); courtesy name Liangbi; fifth in his generation; age twenty-six, born on the twenty-ninth day of the fourth month]. His great-grandfather was Yuan Daolong [Assistant Instructor]; his grandfather was Yuan Ying [Assistant Instructor, posthumously honoured as Investigating Censor]; his father was Yuan Yin [Instructor]; his legal mother was née Xu; and his birth mother is née Zhang. His mother is living. His elder brothers are Yuan Fu, Yuan Xiang [Public-spirited Official], Yuan Shouzheng, and Yuan Lu; his younger brothers are Yuan Yi, Yuan Shouzhong, Yuan Biao, Yuan Yu, and Yuan Qi. He married née Wang. He placed sixty-eighth in the Henan Provincial Examination and two hundred sixty-seventh in the Metropolitan Examination.

translation_en:
Wu Zhen 吳珍 (registered in a civilian household of Changxing County, Huzhou Prefecture, Zhejiang; County Student; specialized in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); courtesy name Rugui 汝貴; eighth in seniority among his brothers; aged twenty-five, born on the twenty-sixth day of the sixth month). His great-grandfather was Wu Zongben 宗本, his grandfather was Wu Yifu 遺夫, his father is Wu Xiaosi 孝思 ( Honorary Official), and his mother was née Zhao 趙氏. His father is living and his mother is deceased. His elder brothers are Wu Jin 璡 (Honorary Official), Wu Qiong 瓊 (Honorary Official), Wu Cheng 珵 (Secretary in the Nanjing Ministry of Justice), Wu Chang 瑺 (Honorary Official), and Wu Bin 瑸; his younger brothers are Wu Chong 珫 and Wu Jing 璥. He is married to née You 游氏. He placed ninth in the Zhejiang Provincial Examination and thirty-second in the Metropolitan Examination.

Wu Cheng 吳誠 (registered in a civilian household of Chun'an County, Yanzhou Prefecture, Zhejiang; National University Student; specialized in the Spring and Autumn Annals (Chunqiu); courtesy name Xingfu 性夫; second in seniority among his brothers; aged thirty-one, born on the fifteenth day of the seventh month). His great-grandfather was Wu Zongli 宗禮 (Office Manager of a Provincial Administration Commission), his grandfather was Wu Wenzhao 文昭, his father is Wu Daji 大濟 (Gentleman for Managing Affairs), his mother was née Xu 許氏, and his stepmother is née Yu 余氏. Both his parents are living. His elder brother is Wu Xun 訓; his younger brothers are Wu Zan 讚, Wu Gao 誥, Wu Jian 諫, Wu Zheng 証, Wu Hui 譓, Wu Yin 諲, Wu Shen 詵, Wu Liang 諒, Wu Zhi 誌, and Wu Xun 詢. He is married to née Shang 商氏. He placed forty-sixth in the Zhejiang Provincial Examination and two hundred and sixtieth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Wu Hong 吳洪 (registered in an artisan household of Wujiang County, Suzhou Prefecture, Southern Metropolitan Area [Zhili]; National University Student; specialized in the Classic of Changes (Yijing); courtesy name Yuchou 禹疇; third in seniority among his brothers; aged twenty-eight, born on the eighth day of the first month). 彭綱〔貫江西臨江府清江縣民籍，國子生，治《詩經》，字性仁，行一，年三十四，八月二十三日生〕。曾祖啓元，祖樂忠，父道英，母徐氏。具慶下，弟亞孫、伍弘、仁綬，娶劉氏，繼娶易氏。江西鄉試第一名，會試第一百五十七名。

劉紳〔貫陝西西安府邠州民籍，國子生，治《禮記》，字大章，行二，年三十，十一月二十八日生〕。曾祖文貴，祖琮〔封通政使司右參議〕，父昭〔工部右侍郎〕，母陳氏〔封宜人〕。具慶下，兄縉〔經歴〕，弟〔善完、善純〕繪、紘、綺、〔善亭、善叙〕綸、緒，娶李氏，繼娶楊氏。陝西鄉試第三十七名，會試第九十五名。
translation_en:
Zhao Heling 趙鶴齡 (originally from Heyang County 郃陽縣, Shaanxi, registered under a military household in the Luzhou Guard 瀘州衛, Sichuan; a Directorate Student (guozisheng) specializing in the Classic of History (Shujing); courtesy name Yongnian 永年; first in seniority among his brothers; aged thirty-two, born on the thirteenth day of the second month). His great-grandfather was Mengxi 孟禧, his grandfather was Gui 貴, his father was Gang 剛, and his mother is née Dou 竇. His mother is living; he married née Fan 樊. He placed forty-eighth in the Sichuan Provincial Examination and sixty-eighth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Wang Yue 王嶽 (registered under a commoner household in Luling County 廬陵縣, Ji'an Prefecture 吉安府, Jiangxi; a County Student (xianxuesheng) specializing in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); courtesy name Yangsong 仰嵩; fourth in seniority among his brothers; aged forty, born on the thirteenth day of the third month). His great-grandfather was Maochun 茂春, his grandfather was Zishan 資善, his father was Chongzhi 崇志, and his mother is née Chen 陳. His mother is living; his elder brothers are Yangji 仰極, Yangwen 仰文, and Yangguan 仰觀; he married née Liu 劉. He placed fifty-third in the Jiangxi Provincial Examination and one hundred and forty-first in the Metropolitan Examination.

Peng Gang 彭綱 (registered under a commoner household in Qingjiang County 清江縣, Linjiang Prefecture 臨江府, Jiangxi; a Directorate Student specializing in the Classic of Poetry; courtesy name Xingren 性仁; first in seniority among his brothers; aged thirty-four, born on the twenty-third day of the eighth month). His great-grandfather was Qiyuan 啓元, his grandfather was Lezhong 樂忠, his father is Daoying 道英, and his mother is née Xu 徐. Both parents are living; his younger brothers are Yasun 亞孫, Wuhong 伍弘, and Renshou 仁綬; he married née Liu 劉, and subsequently married née Yi 易. He placed first in the Jiangxi Provincial Examination and one hundred and fifty-seventh in the Metropolitan Examination.

Liu Shen 劉紳 (registered under a commoner household in Bin Subprefecture 邠州, Xi'an Prefecture 西安府, Shaanxi; a Directorate Student specializing in the Record of Rites (Liji); courtesy name Dazhang 大章; second in seniority among his brothers; aged thirty, born on the twenty-eighth day of the eleventh month). His great-grandfather was Wengui 文貴, his grandfather was Cong 琮 (granted the title of Right Assistant Commissioner in the Office of Transmission), his father is Zhao 昭 (Right Vice Minister of Works), and his mother is née Chen 陳 (granted the title of Lady of Suitability). Both parents are living; his elder brother is Jin 縉 (Registrar), and his younger brothers are [also named Shanwan 善完 and Shanchun 善純] Hui 繪, Hong 紘, Qi 綺, [also named Shanting 善亭 and Shanxu 善叙] Lun 綸, and Xu 緒; he married née Li 李, and subsequently married née Yang 楊. He placed thirty-seventh in the Shaanxi Provincial Examination and ninety-fifth in the Metropolitan Examination.

punctuated:
張本〔貫浙江杭州府錢塘縣民籍，國子生，治《易經》，字孟端，行一，年三十九，九月初五日生〕。曾祖用明，祖富，父恭，母陳氏。重慶下。弟栗。娶李氏。浙江鄉試第二名，會試第三十七名。

毛倫〔貫山西太平縣人，直隸鎮朔衛官籍，國子生，治《禮記》，字秉彞，行三，年三十二，正月初八日生〕。曾祖中正，祖清，父德〔義官〕，母董氏。具慶下。兄軼、永，弟儀。娶錢氏。順天府鄉試第一百十名，會試第一百七十八名。

廖中〔貫福建延平府順昌縣民籍，國子生，治《書經》，字用中，行六，年四十一，五月二十九日生〕。曾祖明玉，祖孟爵，父興，母楊氏，繼母楊氏、趙氏。具慶下。兄康、節，弟昂、晟、昺、昊、冕。娶謝氏。應天府鄉試第一百三十二名，會試第三十一名。

章玄應〔貫浙江溫州府樂清縣軍籍，國子生，治《詩經》，字順德，行十二，年三十三，四月初十日生〕。曾祖新民〔贈南京禮部右侍郎〕，祖文寶〔贈南京禮部右侍郎〕，父綸〔南京禮部左侍郎〕，母朱氏〔封淑人〕。具慶下。兄玄懋〔訓導〕、玄清、玄俊，弟玄會〔國子生〕。娶蔡氏。浙江鄉試第二十名，會試第十九名。
translation_en:
Zhang Ben 張本 (registered under civilian household status in Qiantang County, Hangzhou Prefecture, Zhejiang; a Student of the Directorate of Education specializing in the Classic of Changes (Yijing); courtesy name Mengduan, first in seniority among his brothers; aged thirty-nine, born on the fifth day of the ninth month). His great-grandfather was Yongming, his grandfather was Fu, his father is Gong, and his mother is née Chen. Both his parents and grandparents are living. His younger brother is Li. He married née Li. He placed second in the Zhejiang Provincial Examination and thirty-seventh in the Metropolitan Examination.

Mao Lun 毛倫 (originally from Taiping County, Shanxi, registered under military officer household status in the Zhenshuo Guard in the Metropolitan Area; a Student of the Directorate of Education specializing in the Record of Rites (Liji); courtesy name Bingyi, third in seniority among his brothers; aged thirty-two, born on the eighth day of the first month). His great-grandfather was Zhongzheng, his grandfather was Qing, his father is De (Honorary Official), and his mother is née Dong. Both parents are living. His elder brothers are Yi and Yong, and his younger brother is Yi. He married née Qian. He placed 110th in the Shuntian Prefectural Provincial Examination and 178th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Liao Zhong 廖中 (registered under civilian household status in Shunchang County, Yanping Prefecture, Fujian; a Student of the Directorate of Education specializing in the Classic of History (Shujing); courtesy name Yongzhong, sixth in seniority among his brothers; aged forty-one, born on the twenty-ninth day of the fifth month). His great-grandfather was Mingyu, his grandfather was Mengjue, his father is Xing, his mother was née Yang, and his stepmothers are née Yang and née Zhao. Both parents are living. His elder brothers are Kang and Jie, and his younger brothers are Ang, Sheng, Bing, Hao, and Mian. He married née Xie. He placed 132nd in the Yingtian Prefectural Provincial Examination and thirty-first in the Metropolitan Examination.

Zhang Xuanying 章玄應 (registered under military household status in Yueqing County, Wenzhou Prefecture, Zhejiang; a Student of the Directorate of Education specializing in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); courtesy name Shunde, twelfth in seniority among his brothers; aged thirty-three, born on the tenth day of the fourth month). His great-grandfather was Xinmin (posthumously honoured as Right Vice Minister of Rites in Nanjing), his grandfather was Wenbao (posthumously honoured as Right Vice Minister of Rites in Nanjing), his father is Lun (Left Vice Minister of Rites in Nanjing), and his mother is née Zhu (invested as Lady of Virtue). Both parents are living. His elder brothers are Xuanmao (Assistant Instructor), Xuanqing, and Xuanjun, and his younger brother is Xuanhui (Student of the Directorate of Education). He married née Cai. He placed twentieth in the Zhejiang Provincial Examination and nineteenth in the Metropolitan Examination.

俞經〔貫直隸通州人，南京留守左衛官籍，國子生，治《書經》，字勉誠，行一，年三十一，正月二十七日生〕。曾祖壽四；祖彥清；父良〔義官〕；母錢氏。具慶下。弟綸〔貢士〕、縉、紳〔百戶〕、綬、纓。娶尹氏。應天府鄉試第七名，會試第四十二名。

translation_en:
Zhou Hong 周宏 [registered in a military household of Deqing County, Huzhou Prefecture, Zhejiang; National University Student; specialized in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); courtesy name Maode; second in seniority among his brothers; age twenty-four, born on the thirteenth day of the intercalary ninth month]. His great-grandfather was Zhou Wencheng; his grandfather is Zhou Lun; his father is Zhou Ding [Expectant Appointee]; and his mother is née Shen. Both his parents and grandparents are living. His elder brother is Zhou An; his younger brothers are Zhou Bin, Zhou Kuan, Zhou Ding, Zhou Xian, Zhou Rong, Zhou Huan, Zhou Yin, Zhou Xuan, and Zhou Cai. He married née Fei. He ranked 29th in the Zhejiang Provincial Examination and 71st in the Metropolitan Examination.

Huang Duo 黃鐸 [registered in a civilian household of Putian County, Xinghua Prefecture, Fujian; National University Student; specialized in the Classic of Documents (Shujing); courtesy name Wenqi; first in seniority among his brothers; age thirty-seven, born on the twenty-fifth day of the ninth month]. His great-grandfather was Huang Zecheng; his grandfather was Huang Huan [Confucian Instructor, posthumously granted the title of Investigating Censor]; his father is Huang Yu; and his mother is née Zheng. Both his parents are living. His younger brothers are Huang Rui, Huang He, Huang Quan, Huang Mu [Tribute Student (gongshi)], Huang Hao, Huang Zhen, Huang Dui, Huang Xiang, Huang Jian, Huang Xiu, Huang Yu, and Huang Zhong. He married née Wu. He ranked 28th in the Fujian Provincial Examination and 64th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Yu Jing 俞經 [native of Tongzhou, Zhili, registered in an official household of the Nanjing Left Guard of the Capital Command; National University Student; specialized in the Classic of Documents (Shujing); courtesy name Miancheng; first in seniority among his brothers; age thirty-one, born on the twenty-seventh day of the first month]. His great-grandfather was Yu Shousi; his grandfather was Yu Yanqing; his father is Yu Liang [Honorary Official]; and his mother is née Qian. Both his parents are living. His younger brothers are Yu Lun [Tribute Student (gongshi)], Yu Jin, Yu Shen [Company Commander], Yu Shou, and Yu Ying. He married née Yin. He ranked 7th in the Yingtian Prefectural Provincial Examination and 42nd in the Metropolitan Examination.

Lu Hong 盧鴻 [registered in a civilian household of Chun'an County, Yanzhou Prefecture, Zhejiang; County Student; specialized in the Spring and Autumn Annals (Chunqiu); courtesy name Xiongfei; third in seniority among his brothers; age thirty-one, born on the twenty-third day of the fifth month]. His great-grandfather was Lu Fang; his grandfather was Lu Huai; his father is Lu Zheng; and his mother is née Xu. Both his parents are living. His elder brothers are Lu Guang and Lu Kuan; his younger brothers are Lu Guan, Lu Kui, Lu Long, Lu Qiao, Lu Yue, Lu Heng, Lu Song, and Lu Gao. He married née Fang. He ranked 48th in the Zhejiang Provincial Examination and 52nd in the Metropolitan Examination.

尹珍〔貫江西安福縣人，直隸大河衛軍籍，國子生，治《禮記》，字廷用，行三，年三十四，正月十三日生〕。曾祖恭四，祖二公，父景端，母劉氏。嚴侍下。兄廷璽〔義官〕、廷輝，弟廷美〔七品散官〕、廷儀。娶相氏。應天府鄉試第四十六名，會試第一百二十七名。

徐源〔貫直隸蘇州府長洲縣民籍，國子生，治《易經》，字仲山，行二，年三十六，二月二十七日生〕。曾祖貴三，祖文質，父諒，母任氏。具慶下。兄淵，弟澄、清、淳。娶朱氏。應天府鄉試第五十一名，會試第八十一名。

江貴〔貫江西撫州府金谿縣民籍，國子生，治《書經》，字公輔，行九，年四十四，十一月初七日生〕。曾祖文卿，祖積舟，父汝濱，母傅氏。永感下。兄福、壽、康、寧、顯、榮、華、富，弟全。娶彭氏。江西鄉試第八十五名，會試第二百三十三名。

陸遠〔貫浙江嘉興府秀水縣民籍，國子生，治《書經》，字德毅，行五，年三十六，十月十四日生〕。曾祖用和，祖餘慶，父明善〔贈兵部主事〕，母荆氏〔封太安人〕。慈侍下。兄譽、諲、記、廣〔知府〕。娶葛氏。浙江鄉試第三名，會試第二百十四名。
translation_en:
Yin Zhen 尹珍 [originally from Anfu County 安福縣, Jiangxi, registered in a military household of Dahe Guard 大河衛 in the Metropolitan Area (Zhili 直隸); a Directorate Student (guozisheng 國子生) specializing in the Record of Rites (Liji 禮記); courtesy name Tingyong 廷用, third in seniority among his brothers, aged thirty-four, born on the thirteenth day of the first month]. His great-grandfather was Gongsi 恭四; his grandfather was Ergong 二公; his father is Jingduan 景端; and his mother was née Liu 劉. His father is living and his mother is deceased. His elder brothers are Tingxi 廷璽 [Honorary Official (yiguan 義官)] and Tinghui 廷輝; his younger brothers are Tingmei 廷美 [Prestige Official of the Seventh Rank (qipin sanguan 七品散官)] and Tingyi 廷儀. He married née Xiang 相. He placed 46th in the Yingtian Prefecture 應天府 Provincial Examination and 127th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Xu Yuan 徐源 [registered in a civilian household of Changzhou County 長洲縣, Suzhou Prefecture 蘇州府 in the Metropolitan Area; a Directorate Student specializing in the Classic of Changes (Yijing 易經); courtesy name Zhongshan 仲山, second in seniority among his brothers, aged thirty-six, born on the twenty-seventh day of the second month]. His great-grandfather was Guisan 貴三; his grandfather was Wenzhi 文質; his father is Liang 諒; and his mother is née Ren 任. Both his parents are living. His elder brother is Yuan 淵; his younger brothers are Cheng 澄, Qing 清, and Chun 淳. He married née Zhu 朱. He placed 51st in the Yingtian Prefecture Provincial Examination and 81st in the Metropolitan Examination.

Jiang Gui 江貴 [registered in a civilian household of Jinxi County 金谿縣, Fuzhou Prefecture 撫州府, Jiangxi; a Directorate Student specializing in the Classic of Documents (Shujing 書經); courtesy name Gongfu 公輔, ninth in seniority among his brothers, aged forty-four, born on the seventh day of the eleventh month]. His great-grandfather was Wenqing 文卿; his grandfather was Jizhou 積舟; his father was Rubin 汝濱; and his mother was née Fu 傅. Both his parents are deceased. His elder brothers are Fu 福, Shou 壽, Kang 康, Ning 寧, Xian 顯, Rong 榮, Hua 華, and Fu 富; his younger brother is Quan 全. He married née Peng 彭. He placed 85th in the Jiangxi Provincial Examination and 233rd in the Metropolitan Examination.

Lu Yuan 陸遠 [registered in a civilian household of Xiushui County 秀水縣, Jiaxing Prefecture 嘉興府, Zhejiang; a Directorate Student specializing in the Classic of Documents; courtesy name Deyi 德毅, fifth in seniority among his brothers, aged thirty-six, born on the fourteenth day of the tenth month]. His great-grandfather was Yonghe 用和; his grandfather was Yuqing 餘慶; his father was Mingshan 明善 [posthumously honored as Secretary (zhushi 主事) in the Ministry of War (bingbu 兵部)]; and his mother is née Jing 荆 [invested as Grand Mistress of Peace (tai anren 太安人)]. His mother is living and his father is deceased. His elder brothers are Yu 譽, Yin 諲, Ji 記, and Guang 廣 [Prefect (zhifu 知府)]. He married née Ge 葛. He placed 3rd in the Zhejiang Provincial Examination and 214th in the Metropolitan Examination.

任文遂〔貫福建閩縣人，大寧都司涿州後屯衛軍籍，治《詩經》，字思順，行一，年三十，十月十一日生〕。曾祖本清；祖仕廷；父惟崇〔縣丞〕；母潘氏；繼母高氏。具慶下。弟文進、文道。娶朱氏，繼娶徐氏。順天府鄉試第三十一名，會試第一百五十二名。

耿文睿〔貫山西平陽府曲沃縣民籍，國子生，治《詩經》，字天資，行三，年三十四，八月初七日生〕。曾祖仲寬；祖時振；父純〔通判〕；母劉氏；繼母王氏。具慶下。兄文聰〔貢士〕、文明〔貢士〕；弟文智。娶呉氏。山西鄉試第十二名，會試第一百七十三名。
translation_en:
Liu Gao 劉杲: Registered in a civilian household of Changzhou County, Suzhou Prefecture, Southern Metropolitan Area (Zhili); a County Student specializing in the Classic of Changes (Yijing); courtesy name Shixi, second in seniority among his brothers, aged twenty-five sui, born on the twenty-fourth day of the first month. His great-grandfather was Liu Zhongyu (posthumously granted the title of Drafter in the Central Secretariat); his grandfather was Liu Zongshao; his father was Liu Yanxiu; his father's first wife was née Wu; his mother is née Zhou. His mother is living. His elder brother is Liu Chun. He married née Zhang. He placed 105th in the Yingtian Prefectural Provincial Examination and 49th in the Metropolitan Examination.

He Zhang 和璋: A native of Lingchuan County, Shanxi, registered in a military household of Heyin County, Kaifeng Prefecture, Henan; a County Student specializing in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); courtesy name Wenhui, second in seniority among his brothers, aged twenty-seven sui, born on the twenty-third day of the sixth month. His great-grandfather was He Haogu (County Director of Studies); his grandfather was He Qi (Prefectural Director of Studies); his father is He Wei (Assistant Surveillance Commissioner); his mother is née Tao (invested as Mistress of Peace). Both parents are living. His elder brother is He Wan; his younger brothers are He Min, He Shi, He Hu, He Xu, and He Xu. He married née Zhao. He placed 11th in the Henan Provincial Examination and 138th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Ren Wensui 任文遂: A native of Min County, Fujian, registered in a military household of the Zhuozhou Rear Tun Guard under the Daning Regional Military Commission; specializing in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); courtesy name Sishun, first in seniority among his brothers, aged thirty sui, born on the eleventh day of the tenth month. His great-grandfather was Ren Benqing; his grandfather was Ren Shiting; his father is Ren Weichong (Assistant Magistrate); his mother was née Pan; his stepmother is née Gao. Both parents are living. His younger brothers are Ren Wenjin and Ren Wendao. He married née Zhu, and remarried née Xu. He placed 31st in the Shuntian Prefectural Provincial Examination and 152nd in the Metropolitan Examination.

Geng Wenrui 耿文睿: Registered in a civilian household of Quwo County, Pingyang Prefecture, Shanxi; a National University Student specializing in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); courtesy name Tianzi, third in seniority among his brothers, aged thirty-four sui, born on the seventh day of the eighth month. His great-grandfather was Geng Zhongkuan; his grandfather was Geng Shizhen; his father is Geng Chun (Assistant Prefect); his mother was née Liu; his stepmother is née Wang. Both parents are living. His elder brothers are Geng Wencong (Tribute Student) and Geng Wenming (Tribute Student); his younger brother is Geng Wenzhi. He married née Wu. He placed 12th in the Shanxi Provincial Examination and 173rd in the Metropolitan Examination.

Wu Rui 吳瑞 [registered as a commoner in Kunshan County 崐山縣, Suzhou Prefecture 蘇州府, Southern Metropolitan Area (Zhili 直隸); a Directorate Student (guozisheng 國子生) specializing in the Classic of Changes (Yijing 易經); courtesy name Dezheng 德徵; first in seniority among his brothers; aged thirty-six, born on the eighteenth day of the ninth month]. His great-grandfather was Wu Junbo 吳俊伯, his grandfather was Wu Chong 吳珫, his father is Wu Ding 吳鼎, and his mother is Lady Fan 范氏. Both of his parents are living. His younger brothers are Wu Pei 吳珮, Wu Yue 吳玥, Wu Duo 吳鐸, and Wu Xuan 吳瑄, and he is married to Lady Yu 俞氏. He placed thirty-sixth in the Yingtian Prefecture 應天府 Provincial Examination and sixty-second in the Metropolitan Examination.

Zhu Rang 諸讓 [registered in an official household in Yuyao County 餘姚縣, Shaoxing Prefecture 紹興府, Zhejiang 浙江; a Directorate Student specializing in the Record of Rites (Liji 禮記); courtesy name Yanghe 養和; twelfth in seniority in his generation; aged thirty-seven, born on the twelfth day of the seventh month]. His great-grandfather was Zhu Hezhong 諸和仲, his grandfather was Zhu Shengzong 諸勝宗, his father is Zhu Hao 諸浩 [invested with the title of Secretary of a Bureau in the Ministry of Justice (Xingbu zhushi 刑部主事)], his mother was Lady Fang 方氏 [posthumously honored as Grand Mistress of Peace (tai anren 太安人)], and his stepmother was Lady Ye 葉氏. His father is living. His elder brothers are Zhu E 諸諤, Zhu Zheng 諸正 [Assistant Surveillance Commissioner (anchasi qianshi 按察司僉事)], Zhu Yong 諸詠, Zhu Hui 諸譓, and Zhu Jian 諸諫 [Tribute Student / Metropolitan Examination qualifier (gongshi 貢士)], and his younger brother is Zhu Shi 諸謚; he is married to Lady Zhang 張氏. He placed thirty-fourth in the Zhejiang Provincial Examination and fifty-sixth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Zhao En 趙恩 [registered in a military household in Guide Subprefecture 歸德州, Kaifeng Prefecture 開封府, Henan 河南; a Directorate Student specializing in the Classic of History (Shujing 書經); courtesy name Yunren 允仁; first in seniority among his brothers; aged thirty-six, born on the seventeenth day of the sixth month]. His great-grandfather was Zhao Zhun 趙準, his grandfather was Zhao Cong 趙琮 [Preceptor of the Prefectural Medical School (yixue xunke 醫學訓科)], his father was Zhao Gang 趙綱, his mother was Lady Liu 劉氏, and his stepmothers were Lady Liu 劉氏 and Lady Zhu 朱氏. His mother (or stepmother) is living. His younger brothers are Zhao Hui 趙惠 and Zhao Yu 趙愈, and he is married to Lady Zhang 張氏. He placed twentieth in the Henan Provincial Examination and one hundred eighty-sixth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Wang Sheng 王盛 [registered in a military household in Hancheng County 韓城縣, Tongzhou Subprefecture 同州, Xi'an Prefecture 西安府, Shaanxi 陝西; a Directorate Student specializing in the Classic of History (Shujing 書經); courtesy name Maode 懋德; third in seniority among his brothers; aged thirty-six, born on the tenth day of the third month]. His great-grandfather was Wang Ziwei 王子偉, his grandfather was Wang Cheng 王成, his father is Wang Hui 王惠, and his mother is Lady Liu 劉氏. Both of his parents are living. His elder brothers are Wang Rong 王榮 and Wang Chang 王昌, and his younger brothers are Wang Dun 王敦 and Wang Hou 王厚; he is married to Lady Wei 韋氏. He placed third in the Shaanxi Provincial Examination and two hundred fifty-eighth in the Metropolitan Examination.

His great-grandfather was Bi Er; his grandfather was Bi Duo; his father is Bi Li (Instructor); and his mother is née Gao. Both parents are living. His elder brothers are Bi Yong and Bi Yun, and his younger brothers are Bi Song and Bi Cheng. He is married to née Luo. He placed second in the Shandong Provincial Examination and thirty-fifth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Lu Cheng 魯誠 (registered in Shanyin County, Shaoxing Prefecture, Zhejiang, under military household status; National University Student; specialized in the Spring and Autumn Annals [Chunqiu]; courtesy name Wenming; third in seniority among brothers; aged thirty-two, born on the eighteenth day of the seventh month). His great-grandfather was Lu Yanming; his grandfather was Lu Bengong; his father is Lu Huan; and his mother is née Tao. Both parents are living. His elder brothers are Lu Rang and Lu Qian, and his younger brothers are Lu Zan, Lu Lin, Lu Jie, Lu Gao, Lu Fang, and Lu Lan. He is married to née Liu. He placed twenty-sixth in the Zhejiang Provincial Examination and sixteenth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Qin Huan 秦瓛 (registered in Kunshan County, Suzhou Prefecture, Southern Metropolitan Area [Zhili], under artisan household status; National University Student; specialized in the Classic of Changes [Yijing]; courtesy name Tingzan; first in seniority among brothers; aged thirty-two, born on the seventeenth day of the fourth month). His great-grandfather was Qin Shengsi; his grandfather was Qin Ang; his father is Qin Gong; and his mother is née Zhou. Both parents are living. His younger brothers are Qin Xuan and Qin Xiu. He is married to née Sun. He placed fifteenth in the Yingtian Prefectural Provincial Examination and two hundred and eleventh in the Metropolitan Examination.

Zhu Kai 朱愷 (registered in Putian County, Xinghua Prefecture, Fujian, under civilian household status; National University Student; specialized in the Classic of Poetry [Shijing]; courtesy name Shunzheng; first in seniority among brothers; aged thirty-four, born on the tenth day of the tenth month). His great-grandfather was Zhu Zhongyong (Official of a Fishing Tax Office); his grandfather was Zhu Shangbai; his father is Zhu Tiguang; and his mother is née Chen. Both parents are living. His younger brother is Zhu Ti (Tribute Student [gongshi]). He is married to née Xu. 吳嵩〔貫江西撫州府臨川縣民籍，國子生，治《詩經》，字中立，行二，年三十二，八月二十一日生〕。曾祖則彥，祖仕彰，父天常，母李氏。重慶下，兄山，弟嶽、岱，娶汪氏。江西鄉試第五十名，會試第一百九十五名。

劉時〔貫江西吉安府永新縣民籍，縣學增廣生，治《易經》，字本升，行六，年三十五，八月初八日生〕。曾祖德甫，祖著，父均，嫡母姜氏，生母楊氏。永感下，兄益、制、器、信、和，弟識、亨，娶王氏。江西鄉試第五十五名，會試第九名。

冒政〔貫直隸揚州府泰州民籍，州學生，治《詩經》，字有恒，行一，年三十三，十一月十四日生〕。曾祖仲智〔訓導〕，祖永平，父鑑，母王氏。具慶下，弟文，娶彭氏。應天府鄉試第三十四名，會試第六十一名。
translation_en:
Yao Bing 姚昺 (courtesy name Maoming 懋明, first in seniority among brothers) was originally from Wu County 吳縣 in the Southern Metropolitan Area (Zhili 直隸) and registered as an artisan household in the Nanjing Embroidered-Uniform Guard (Nanjing Jinyiwei 南京錦衣衛). A National University Student (guozisheng 國子生) specializing in the Spring and Autumn Annals (Chunqiu 春秋), he was thirty-three sui, born on the sixth day of the seventh month. His great-grandfather was Yao Jizhi 繼之, his grandfather Yao Zhong 中, his father Yao Kan 侃, his mother Madam Jin 金氏, and his stepmother Madam Xu 徐氏. Both his father and stepmother were living (juqing xia 具慶下). His younger brothers were Yao Yan 晏, Yao Sheng 昇, Yao Kun 昆, and Yao Guo 果, and he married Madam Zhou 周氏. He placed 102nd in the Yingtian Prefectural 應天府 Provincial Examination and 74th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Wu Song 吳嵩 (courtesy name Zhongli 中立, second in seniority) was registered as a civilian household in Linchuan County 臨川縣, Fuzhou Prefecture 撫州府, Jiangxi 江西. A National University Student specializing in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing 詩經), he was thirty-two sui, born on the twenty-first day of the eighth month. His great-grandfather was Wu Zeyan 則彥, his grandfather Wu Shizhang 仕彰, his father Wu Tianchang 天常, and his mother Madam Li 李氏. Both his parents and grandparents were living (chongqing xia 重慶下). His elder brother was Wu Shan 山, his younger brothers were Wu Yue 嶽 and Wu Dai 岱, and he married Madam Wang 汪氏. He placed 50th in the Jiangxi Provincial Examination and 195th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Liu Shi 劉時 (courtesy name Bensheng 本升, sixth in seniority) was registered as a civilian household in Yongxin County 永新縣, Ji'an Prefecture 吉安府, Jiangxi. AnAdded Student (zengguangsheng 增廣生) of the county Confucian school specializing in the Classic of Changes (Yijing 易經), he was thirty-five sui, born on the eighth day of the eighth month. His great-grandfather was Liu Defu 德甫, his grandfather Liu Zhu 著, his father Liu Jun 均, his legal mother Madam Jiang 姜氏, and his birth mother Madam Yang 楊氏. Both of his parents were deceased (yonggan xia 永感下). His elder brothers were Liu Yi 益, Liu Zhi 制, Liu Qi 器, Liu Xin 信, and Liu He 和; his younger brothers were Liu Shi 識 and Liu Heng 亨; and he married Madam Wang 王氏. He placed 55th in the Jiangxi Provincial Examination and 9th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Mao Zheng 冒政 (courtesy name Youheng 有恒, first in seniority) was registered as a civilian household in Taizhou Subprefecture 泰州, Yangzhou Prefecture 揚州府, in the Metropolitan Area (Zhili). A Student (xuesheng 學生) of the subprefectural Confucian school specializing in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing), he was thirty-three sui, born on the fourteenth day of the eleventh month. His great-grandfather was Mao Zhongzhi 仲智 (Assistant Instructor, Xundao 訓導), his grandfather Mao Yongping 永平, his father Mao Jian 鑑, and his mother Madam Wang 王氏. Both of his parents were living (juqing xia). His younger brother was Mao Wen 文, and he married Madam Peng 彭氏. He placed 34th in the Yingtian Prefectural Provincial Examination and 61st in the Metropolitan Examination.

陸怡〔貫直隸常州府武進縣軍籍，國子生，治《詩經》，字順之，行三，年四十五，四月二十九日生〕。曾祖富；祖朝宗；父淵〔教諭，贈戶部郎中〕；母李氏〔封太宜人〕。慈侍下。兄愷〔戶部郎中〕、悌，弟愉〔刑部主事〕。娶陳氏。應天府鄉試第九十九名，會試第一百五十名。

黃鉞〔貫湖廣長沙府湘陰縣軍籍，國子生，治《書經》，字廷威，行二，年四十，十月初九日生〕。曾祖潮瑛；祖德明；父篪；嫡母吳氏，生母喻氏。永感下。兄鍚，弟銳、鏡、鑑、鐮。娶劉氏。湖廣鄉試第六十四名，會試第二百九十四名。

劉定昌〔貫四川重慶府綦江縣軍籍，縣學生，治《詩經》，字邦泰，行四，年二十九，四月初六日生〕。曾祖幹辰〔知事〕；祖仲端；父哲；母凌氏。具慶下。兄復昌、德昌、景昌，弟守昌、原昌。娶吳氏。四川鄉試第十八名，會試第二百三十六名。

周鳳〔貫湖廣常德府龍陽縣軍籍，縣學生，治《易經》，字文明，行二，年三十五，六月初九日生〕。曾祖思午；祖之美；父和；母趙氏。慈侍下。兄鳳呈。娶廖氏。湖廣鄉試第四十三名，會試第一百二十三名。
translation_en:
Lu Yi 陸怡 (native of Wujin County 武進縣, Changzhou Prefecture 常州府, Southern Metropolitan Area 直隸, of military registration; National University Student, specializing in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); courtesy name Shunzhi 順之; third in seniority; aged forty-five, born on the twenty-ninth day of the fourth month). His great-grandfather was Lu Fu 富; his grandfather was Lu Chaozong 朝宗; his father was Lu Yuan 淵 (Instructor, posthumously honored as Bureau Director in the Ministry of Revenue); and his mother is Lady Li 李氏 (invested as Grand Lady of Suitability). His mother is living while his father is deceased. His elder brothers are Lu Kai 愷 (Bureau Director in the Ministry of Revenue) and Lu Ti 悌, and his younger brother is Lu Yu 愉 (Bureau Secretary in the Ministry of Justice). He is married to Lady Chen 陳氏. He placed 99th in the Yingtian Prefecture 應天府 Provincial Examination and 150th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Huang Yue 黃鉞 (native of Xiangyin County 湘陰縣, Changsha Prefecture 長沙府, Huguang 湖廣, of military registration; National University Student, specializing in the Classic of Documents (Shujing); courtesy name Tingwei 廷威; second in seniority; aged forty, born on the ninth day of the tenth month). His great-grandfather was Huang Chaoying 潮瑛; his grandfather was Huang Deming 德明; his father was Huang Chi 篪; his legal mother was Lady Wu 吳氏, and his birth mother was Lady Yu 喻氏. Both of his parents are deceased. His elder brother is Huang Xi 鍚, and his younger brothers are Huang Rui 銳, Huang Jing 鏡, Huang Jian 鑑, and Huang Lian 鐮. He is married to Lady Liu 劉氏. He placed 64th in the Huguang Provincial Examination and 294th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Liu Dingchang 劉定昌 (native of Qijiang County 綦江縣, Chongqing Prefecture 重慶府, Sichuan 四川, of military registration; County School Student, specializing in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); courtesy name Bangtai 邦泰; fourth in seniority; aged twenty-nine, born on the sixth day of the fourth month). His great-grandfather was Liu Ganchen 幹辰 (Administrative Clerk); his grandfather was Liu Zhongduan 仲端; his father is Liu Zhe 哲; and his mother is Lady Ling 凌氏. Both of his parents are living. His elder brothers are Liu Fuchang 復昌, Liu Dechang 德昌, and Liu Jingchang 景昌, and his younger brothers are Liu Shouchang 守昌 and Liu Yuanchang 原昌. He is married to Lady Wu 吳氏. He placed 18th in the Sichuan Provincial Examination and 236th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Zhou Feng 周鳳 (native of Longyang County 龍陽縣, Changde Prefecture 常德府, Huguang 湖廣, of military registration; County School Student, specializing in the Classic of Changes (Yijing); courtesy name Wenming 文明; second in seniority; aged thirty-five, born on the ninth day of the sixth month). His great-grandfather was Zhou Siwu 思午; his grandfather was Zhou Zhimei 之美; his father was Zhou He 和; and his mother is Lady Zhao 趙氏. His mother is living while his father is deceased. His elder brother is Zhou Fengcheng 鳳呈. He is married to Lady Liao 廖氏. He placed 43rd in the Huguang Provincial Examination and 123rd in the Metropolitan Examination.

translation_en:
Zhao Ming 趙明 [registered in a military household of the Fuzhou Right Guard in Fujian, a National University Student (guozi sheng), specialized in the Spring and Autumn Annals (Chunqiu), courtesy name Kongzhao 孔昭, seventh in his generation, aged thirty-two, born on the eleventh day of the ninth month]. His great-grandfather was Sicheng 嗣誠, his grandfather was Bosheng 伯昇, his father is Tong 統, and his mother is née Gao 高. Both parents are living; he has elder brothers Hui 輝 and Guang 光, and a younger brother Liang 亮, and he married née Lin 林. He placed fourth in the Fujian Provincial Examination and twenty-seventh in the Metropolitan Examination.

Pan Qi 潘祺 [registered in a commoner household of Tiantai County, Taizhou Prefecture, Zhejiang, a Confucian scholar (rushi), specialized in the Book of Documents (Shujing), courtesy name Yingsheng 應昇, fourth in his generation, aged twenty-nine, born on the twenty-first day of the twelfth month]. His great-grandfather was Shu'an 叔安, his grandfather was Bozhuang 伯莊, his father was Wei 偉 [Prefectural Director of Schools (jiaoshou)], and his mother was née Zhang 張. Both parents are deceased; he has elder brothers Zhen 禎 [Case Reviewer of the Left in the Nanjing Court of Judicial Review (Nanjing dalisi zuo sizheng)], Xiang 祥, and Ji 禨, and he married née Zhao 趙. He placed forty-second in the Zhejiang Provincial Examination and two hundred thirty-second in the Metropolitan Examination.

Pan Hong 潘洪 [registered in a commoner household of Suqian County, Pizhou Department, Huai'an Prefecture, Southern Metropolitan Area (Zhili), a National University Student, specialized in the Record of Rites (Liji), courtesy name Yufu 裕夫, first in his generation, aged thirty-seven, born on the nineteenth day of the tenth month]. His great-grandfather was De 得, his grandfather was Zhi 智 [Honorary Official (yiguan)], his father is Min 敏 [Registrar of a Pacification Commission (xuanfu si jingli)], and his mother is née Wang 王. Both parents are living; he has younger brothers Qing 清, Lian 亷, Chun 淳, Zi 滋, and Run 潤, and he married née Tang 唐. He placed fifty-third in the Yingtian Prefectural (Provincial) Examination and two hundred seventeenth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Liu Peng 劉鵬 [registered in a commoner household of Xiangfu County, Kaifeng Prefecture, Henan, a National University Student, specialized in the Book of Documents (Shujing), courtesy name Tunan 圖南, second in his generation, aged thirty-two, born on the fourth day of the sixth month]. His great-grandfather was Shihong 士弘, his grandfather was Yuanjie 源潔 [posthumously granted the title of Investigating Censor (jiancha yushi)], his father was Qian 謙 [Prefect (zhifu)], his legal mother was née Tong 仝 [enfeoffed as Child Nurturer (ruren)], and his birth mother is née Fan 樊. His mother is living (father deceased); he has an elder brother E 鶚, and he married née Wang 王. He placed forty-eighth in the Henan Provincial Examination and two hundred seventy-sixth in the Metropolitan Examination.

童祝〔貫浙江金華府蘭谿縣軍籍，國子生，治《易經》，字勉和，行五，年三十八，四月初三日生〕。曾祖士郁；祖原武；父存正〔教授〕；母范氏。重慶下。兄權、榮、櫻；弟桂、棟、寄。娶張氏，繼娶劉氏。浙江鄉試第二十六名，會試第二百三十二名。

周盈〔貫江西吉安府吉水縣軍籍，縣學生，治《詩經》，字謙之，行一，年三十一，正月十四日生〕。曾祖子導；祖仲修；父允瞻；母王氏。具慶下。弟盛、益、盛。娶楊氏。江西鄉試第八十九名，會試第二百五十三名。
translation_en:
Yang Gao 楊杲 [originally from Longyang County 龍陽縣, Huguang 湖廣, registered in a military household of the Chengdu Front Guard 成都前衛 in Sichuan 四川; a National University Student (guozisheng) specializing in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); courtesy name Menghui 孟暉; first in seniority among his brothers; aged thirty-four, born on the eleventh day of the fifth month]. His great-grandfather was Yang Shoutong 楊壽通; his grandfather was Yang Bin 楊斌; his father was Yang Sheng 楊昇; his mother was née Zhao 趙氏, and his stepmother is née Dai 戴氏. Both of his parents are living. His younger brothers are Yang Nie 楊臬, Yang Rong 楊榮, and Yang Can 楊粲. He married née Shen 沈氏. He placed thirty-ninth in the Sichuan Provincial Examination and one hundred seventieth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Xu Bi 許弼 [registered in a military household of Dong'an County 東安縣, Shuntian Prefecture 順天府; a National University Student specializing in the Classic of Poetry; courtesy name Youzhi 佑之; fourth in seniority among his brothers; aged thirty-seven, born on the nineteenth day of the twelfth month]. His great-grandfather was Xu Deyou 許得友; his grandfather was Xu Zhong 許忠 [Office Director (shuzheng)]; his father was Xu Ying 許瑛 [Assistant Magistrate (xiancheng)]; his mother was née Shi 石氏, and his stepmother is née Zhang 張氏. His mother (stepmother) is living. His elder brothers are Xu Zhen 許震, Xu Xuan 許宣, and Xu Fu 許輔 [Secretary (zhushi) in the Ministry of Revenue]; his younger brothers are Xu Wen 許文 and Xu Wu 許武. He married née Sun 孫氏. He placed one hundred seventeenth in the Shuntian Prefectural Provincial Examination and eighty-ninth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Tong Zhu 童祝 [registered in a military household of Lanxi County 蘭谿縣, Jinhua Prefecture 金華府, Zhejiang 浙江; a National University Student specializing in the Classic of Changes (Yijing); courtesy name Mianhe 勉和; fifth in seniority among his brothers; aged thirty-eight, born on the third day of the fourth month]. His great-grandfather was Tong Shiyu 童士郁; his grandfather is Tong Yuanwu 童原武; his father is Tong Cunzheng 童存正 [Prefectural Director of Studies (jiaoshou)]; his mother is née Fan 范氏. Both his parents and grandparents are living. His elder brothers are Tong Quan 童權, Tong Rong 童榮, and Tong Ying 童櫻; his younger brothers are Tong Gui 童桂, Tong Dong 童棟, and Tong Ji 童寄. He married née Zhang 張氏, and remarried née Liu 劉氏. He placed twenty-sixth in the Zhejiang Provincial Examination and two hundred thirty-second in the Metropolitan Examination.

Zhou Ying 周盈 [registered in a military household of Jishui County 吉水縣, Ji'an Prefecture 吉安府, Jiangxi 江西; a County Student (xianxuesheng) specializing in the Classic of Poetry; courtesy name Qianzhi 謙之; first in seniority among his brothers; aged thirty-one, born on the fourteenth day of the first month]. His great-grandfather was Zhou Zidao 周子導; his grandfather was Zhou Zhongxiu 周仲修; his father is Zhou Yunzhan 周允瞻; his mother is née Wang 王氏. Both of his parents are living. His younger brothers are Zhou Sheng 周盛, Zhou Yi 周益, and Zhou Sheng 周盛 [?]. He married née Yang 楊氏. He placed eighty-ninth in the Jiangxi Provincial Examination and two hundred fifty-third in the Metropolitan Examination.

童蘭〔貫河南孟津縣人，府軍左衛官籍。國子生，治《易經》。字世馨，行五，年二十七，六月二十五日生〕。曾祖伯章，祖友福，父銘〔百戶〕，母石氏。具慶下。兄興、英、芳、茂。娶朱氏。順天府鄉試第十八名，會試第一百五十九名。

translation_en:
Tong Lan 童蘭: A native of Mengjin County, Henan, registered in an official household under the Left Imperial Bodyguard Guard. He is a student of the Directorate of Education specializing in the Classic of Changes. His courtesy name is Shixin, he is fifth in his family's generational birth order, and he is twenty-seven sui, born on the twenty-fifth day of the sixth month. His great-grandfather was Tong Bozhang, his grandfather was Tong Youfu, his father is Tong Ming (a Platoon Commander), and his mother is née Shi. Both of his parents are living. His elder brothers are Tong Xing, Tong Ying, Tong Fang, and Tong Mao; he is married to née Zhu. He placed eighteenth in the Shuntian Prefecture Provincial Examination and one hundred fifty-ninth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Lou Dong 樓東: Registered in a civilian household in Yin County, Ningbo Prefecture, Zhejiang. He is a Confucian scholar without student status specializing in the Classic of Documents. His courtesy name is Qiming, he is sixth in his family's generational birth order, and he is twenty-three sui, born on the eighteenth day of the first month. His great-grandfather was Lou Zongbao, his grandfather was Lou Yue, his father is Lou Jun, and his mother is née Zhou. Both of his parents are living. His elder brother is Lou Wei (an Instructor); his younger brothers are Lou Jing, Lou Jing [亰], Lou Xiang, Lou Mao, Lou Ce, and Lou Bao. He is married to née Wang. He placed sixty-third in the Zhejiang Provincial Examination and one hundred sixteenth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Guan Da 管達: Registered in a military household in Anfu County, Ji'an Prefecture, Jiangxi. He is a student of the Directorate of Education specializing in the Spring and Autumn Annals. His courtesy name is Shengkui, he is sixth in his family's generational birth order, and he is thirty-two sui, born on the twenty-third day of the twelfth month. His great-grandfather was Guan Zixun, his grandfather was Guan Yiru, his father was Guan Ji, and his mother is née Peng. His mother is living. His elder brother is Guan Shengzai (an Usher), and his younger brother is Guan Shenggao; he is married to née Liu. He placed thirty-first in the Jiangxi Provincial Examination and one hundred thirty-seventh in the Metropolitan Examination.

Wang Mao 王懋: Registered in a military household in Yizhou, Yanzhou Prefecture, Shandong. He is a subprefectural student specializing in the Classic of Odes. His courtesy name is Mianzhi, he is first in his family's generational birth order, and he is thirty-two sui, born on the second day of the tenth month. His great-grandfather was Wang Fengli, his grandfather was Wang Zheng, his father is Wang Qi, and his mother was née Jiang. His father is living. His younger brothers are Wang Dongtai and Wang Dongmeng; he is married to née Jia. He placed seventy-third in the Shandong Provincial Examination and eighty-second in the Metropolitan Examination.

translation_en:
Third Class (San Jia), 202 candidates: Conferred the status of Fellow of the Metropolitan Graduates (Tong Jinshi Chushen).

Zhang Chen 張琛 [registered in an artisan household of Yichuan County, Yan'an Prefecture, Shaanxi; National University Student specializing in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); courtesy name Xianzhi; seniority first; age 31, born on the 21st day of the 6th month]. His great-grandfather was Zhang Jing 敬, his grandfather was Zhang Xi 錫, his father was Zhang Qi 啓 [Vice Prefect], his father's former wife was Lady Liu 劉氏, and his mother is Lady Wang 王氏. His mother is living while his father is deceased (cishixia). His younger brothers are Zhang Xuan 璿 and Zhang Ji 璣, and he is married to Lady Jiang 姜氏. He placed 51st in the Shaanxi Provincial Examination and 55th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Yu Qi 余琦 [registered in a military household of Putian County, Xinghua Prefecture, Fujian; Student of the Pinghai Guard School specializing in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); courtesy name Shizheng; seniority second; age 21, born on the 20th day of the 9th month]. His great-grandfather was Yu Boyong 伯永, his grandfather is Yu Tingju 廷舉, his father is Yu Yonghe 用和, and his mother is Lady Weng 翁氏. Both his parents and grandparents are living (chongqingxia). His elder brother is Yu Tang 瑭, his younger brothers are Yu Jie 玠 and Yu Rui 瑞, and he was married to Lady Zhou 周氏 and subsequently married to Lady Wang 王氏. He placed 35th in the Fujian Provincial Examination and 109th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Wang Gao 王臯 [registered in a civilian household of Huating County, Songjiang Prefecture, Southern Metropolitan Region (Zhili); National University Student specializing in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); courtesy name Shunchen; seniority first; age 34, born on the 22nd day of the 11th month]. His great-grandfather was Wang Jun 俊, his grandfather is Wang Ren 仁 [Honorary Official], his father is Wang Xuan 璇, and his mother is Lady Shen 沈氏. Both his parents and grandparents are living (chongqingxia). His younger brothers are Wang Yu 禹, Wang Kui 夔, Wang Ji 稷, and Wang Xie 契, and he is married to Lady Zhang 張氏. He placed 101st in the Yingtian Prefectural Provincial Examination and 29th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Yu Zhencai 俞振才 (registered in a civilian household in Xinchang County, Shaoxing Prefecture, Zhejiang; Added Student of the County School; specialized in the Classic of Documents [Shujing]; courtesy name Zhencai; first in seniority among his brothers; aged thirty-four, born on the seventeenth day of the eighth month). His great-grandfather was Yu Benqing 本清, his grandfather was Yu Yongzhi 用直, his father is Yu Yong'an 永安, and his mother is née Lü 呂. Both his parents are living. His younger brothers are Yu Hong 鉷, Yu Xin 鐔, Yu Liangzuo 良佐, and Yu Liangchen 良臣, and he is married to née Huang 黃. He placed fifty-third in the Zhejiang Provincial Examination and forty-eighth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Wu Zhe 吳轍 (registered in a civilian household in Xinhui County, Guangzhou Prefecture, Guangdong; National University Student; specialized in the Classic of Poetry [Shijing]; courtesy name Zongzheng 宗正; second in seniority among his brothers; aged thirty-two, born on the sixth day of the fourth month). His great-grandfather was Wu Xianhu 先護, his grandfather was Wu Yunfu 允孚, his father is Wu Bin 斌, and his mother is née Zhao 趙. Both his parents are living. His elder brother is Wu Shi 軾, his younger brothers are Wu Fu 輔 and Wu Fu 輻, and he is married to née Yu 余. He placed seventy-fourth in the Guangdong Provincial Examination and one hundred eighty-seventh in the Metropolitan Examination.

Wu Zhongzhu 吳仲珠 (registered in a military household in Putian County, Xinghua Prefecture, Fujian; National University Student; specialized in the Classic of Poetry [Shijing]; courtesy name Chunfu 純夫; second in seniority among his brothers; aged thirty-eight, born on the tenth day of the tenth month). His great-grandfather was Wu Gongshuo 公說, his grandfather was Wu Shangyu 尚玉, his father was Wu Shaoxuan 紹玄, and his mother is née Lin 林. His mother is living. His elder brother is Wu Mengrui 孟瑞, his younger brothers are Wu Jishi 季石, Wu Ying 瑩, and Wu Po 珀, and he is married to née Weng 翁. He placed third in the Fujian Provincial Examination and two hundred eighty-fifth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Li Hao 李滈 (a native of Chuzhou in the Southern Metropolitan Area [Zhili], registered in a military household of the Yunnan Front Guard in Yunnan; National University Student; specialized in the Classic of Poetry [Shijing]; courtesy name Yuanjie 源潔; fourth in seniority among his brothers; aged twenty-seven, born on the twentieth day of the third month). His great-grandfather was Li Wentong 文通, his grandfather was Li Zhongzhen 仲珍, his father was Li Borang 伯讓, and his mother is née Du 杜. His mother is living. His elder brothers are Li Han 瀚, Li Chun 淳, and Li Shi 湜, his younger brother is Li Ji 濟, and he is married to née Wang 王. He placed fourteenth in the Yunnan Provincial Examination and two hundred fifteenth in the Metropolitan Examination.
