translation_en:
Zhao Tai 趙泰 (courtesy name Shiyong 時雍, first in seniority among his brothers, aged thirty-nine, born on the twenty-fourth day of the twelfth month) was registered in a civilian household in Xianyang County, Xi'an Prefecture, Shaanxi, and served as a National University Student specializing in the Classic of Changes (Yijing). His great-grandfather was Zhao Zhongde; his grandfather was Zhao Ji, Vice Director in a Bureau of the Ministry of Justice; his father was Zhao Xian; and his mother was née He. Both of his parents were living; his younger brothers were Zhao He, Zhao Ying, and Zhao Cai; and he was married to née Zhang. He placed eighteenth in the Shaanxi Provincial Examination and two hundred twenty-third in the Metropolitan Examination.

Xiang Chong 向翀 (courtesy name Jiuxiao 九霄, fifth in seniority among his brothers, aged thirty-two, born on the sixteenth day of the twelfth month) was registered in a military household in Tongjiang County, Baoning Prefecture, Sichuan, and served as a National University Student specializing in the Spring and Autumn Annals (Chunqiu). His great-grandfather was Xiang Zixian; his grandfather was Xiang Ying; his father was Xiang Ming, Prefectural Vice Medical Instructor; and his mother was née Zhao. His mother was living; his elder brothers were Xiang Jun (Prefectural Vice Medical Instructor), Xiang Jie, and Xiang Yi; his younger brothers were Xiang Yan, Xiang Pu, Xiang Chun, Xiang Ying, Xiang Run, and Xiang Huai; and he was married to née Chen. He placed ninth in the Sichuan Provincial Examination and one hundred ninety-ninth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Song Xuan 宋宣 (courtesy name Shida 世達, first in seniority among his brothers, aged forty-five, born on the eighth day of the tenth month) was registered in a civilian household in Huai'an County, Fuzhou Prefecture, Fujian, and served as a National University Student specializing in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing). His great-grandfather was Song Zilong; his grandfather was Song Yao, an Elder Awarded Oficial Cap and Belt; his father was Song Fu; and his mother was née Zhuang. Both of his parents were deceased; his younger brothers were Song Shi, Song Yu, Song An, and Song Hong; and he was married to née Shen. He placed seventy-first in the Fujian Provincial Examination and two hundred sixth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Liu Zan 劉瓚 (courtesy name Guoyong 國用, first in seniority among his brothers, aged thirty-one, born on the thirteenth day of the tenth month) was registered in a military household in Qingyuan County, Baoding Prefecture, Zhili, and served as a Prefectural Student specializing in the Classic of Changes (Yijing). His great-grandfather was Liu Xian; his grandfather was Liu Quan; his father was Liu Sheng; and his mother was née Bai. His mother was living; his younger brother was Liu Duan; and he was married to née Mi. He placed one hundred thirty-second in the Shuntian Prefectural Examination and two hundred eighth in the Metropolitan Examination.

His great-grandfather was Ge Weishan 惟善, his grandfather Ge Ben 本, his father Ge Ning 寧, his mother née Zhu 朱氏, and his stepmother née Yang 楊氏. Both parents are living. His elder brothers are Ge Rui 瑞, Ge Min 敏, Ge Zan 瓚, and Ge Jing 敬; his younger brothers are Ge Zi 孜, Ge Wei 亹, Ge Chang 敞, Ge Yan 琰, Ge Xu 敘, and Ge Zhen 珍. He is married to née Guo 郭氏. Wu Qing 武清 (registered in a civilian household of Kelan Department 岢嵐州, Taiyuan Prefecture 太原府, Shanxi 山西; a Department Student [Zhouxuesheng 州學生] specializing in the Classic of Poetry [Shijing]; courtesy name Yuanjie 源潔; first in seniority among his brothers; aged twenty-four, born on the ninth day of the seventh month). He married née Guo 郭氏 and remarried née Wang 王氏. He placed 44th in the Shanxi Provincial Examination and 168th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Wen Rui 文瑞 (registered in a military household of Jiexiu County 介休縣, Fen Department 汾州, Shanxi 山西; a National University Student specializing in the Classic of History [Shujing]; courtesy name Yingxiang 應祥; first in seniority among his brothers; aged thirty-two, born on the twentieth day of the eighth month). His younger brother is Xiao Wucheng 武成. He married née Liu 劉氏 and remarried née Zhou 周氏. He placed 26th in the Jiangxi Provincial Examination and 129th in the Metropolitan Examination.

translation_en:
Feng Heng 馮衡 (registered in a civilian household of Hezhou in Chongqing Prefecture, Sichuan; National University Student specializing in the Classic of History (Shujing); courtesy name Pingshu; first in seniority among his brothers; aged thirty, born on the twenty-fifth day of the tenth month). His great-grandfather was Feng Deqing; his grandfather was Feng Lin; his father was Feng Benxue, his mother was née Xu, and his stepmother is née Chen. His stepmother is living. His younger brothers are Feng Qu, Feng Kan, Feng Yan, Feng Xiang, and Feng Shu. He married née Liu. He placed 45th in the Sichuan Provincial Examination and 160th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Huang Xuan 黃玹 (registered in a military household of Puqi County in Wuchang Prefecture, Huguang; National University Student specializing in the Classic of History (Shujing); courtesy name Jingrun; eighth in seniority among his brothers; aged thirty-eight, born on the nineteenth day of the eighth month). His great-grandfather was Huang Ji; his grandfather was Huang Yu (Instructor); his father was Huang Cheng (Assistant Instructor), and his mother is née Xiong. His mother is living. His elder brothers are Huang Ju, Huang Lin, Huang Yi, Huang Zhen, and Huang Jing; his younger brothers are Huang Zhen, Huang Gong, Huang Hu, and Huang Liu. He married née Shi. He placed 44th in the Huguang Provincial Examination and 272nd in the Metropolitan Examination.

Yang Lian 楊璉 (registered in a civilian household of Xiangfu County in Kaifeng Prefecture, Henan; County Student specializing in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); courtesy name Yongzhang; second in seniority among his brothers; aged thirty-two, born on the tenth day of the second month). His great-grandfather was Yang Siyi; his grandfather was Yang Chun; his father is Yang Ming, his mother was née Liu, and his stepmother is née Chen. Both his father and stepmother are living. His elder brother is Yang Cong; his younger brothers are Yang Ji, Yang Sui, Yang Pei, Yang Guan, Yang Qiong, Yang Lin, and Yang Chen. He married née Zhen. He placed 69th in the Henan Provincial Examination and 213th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Lan Hong 藍洪 (registered in a military household of the Dengzhou Independent Chiliarchy under the Nanyang Guard, Henan; National University Student specializing in the Record of Rites (Liji); courtesy name Zonghao; first in seniority among his brothers; aged forty-five, born on the twenty-ninth day of the eleventh month). His great-grandfather was Lan Gui; his grandfather was Lan Xing; his father was Lan Ju, his mother was née Wang, and his stepmother was née Tian. Both parents are deceased. His younger brothers are Lan Hai and Lan Cheng. He married née Gan. He placed 34th in the Henan Provincial Examination and 289th in the Metropolitan Examination.

胡英〔貫浙江嘉興府秀水縣民籍，國子生，治《詩經》，字廷俊，行一，年四十四，六月二十六日生〕。曾祖均珎；祖德銘；父璉〔進士〕；母王氏。永感下。弟芳〔訓導〕、芬。娶烏氏，繼娶黃氏。應天府鄉試第三十二名，會試第二百二十七名。

translation_en:
Cao Ying 曹英 (registered in a civilian household of Shouzhang County, Yanzhou Prefecture, Shandong; National University Student; specialized in the Spring and Autumn Annals (Chunqiu); courtesy name Shijie; second in seniority; aged thirty-seven, born on the fifteenth day of the seventh month). His great-grandfather was Cao Tai; his grandfather was Cao Ziliang; his father is Cao Sheng (Assistant County Magistrate); his mother was née Liu, and his stepmothers were née Li and née Zhang. Both parents (father and stepmother) are living. His elder brother is Cao Zan. He married née Pang, and subsequently married née Ji. He ranked nineteenth in the Shandong Provincial Examination and two hundred twenty-eighth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Cao Lan 曹瀾 (registered in a civilian household of Jurong County, Yingtian Prefecture; National University Student; specialized in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); courtesy name Wenyuan; twenty-third in seniority; aged thirty-nine, born on the fifteenth day of the seventh month). His great-grandfather was Cao Jun'ang (posthumously honoured as Minister of Personnel); his grandfather was Cao Zichen (invested as Investigating Censor); his father is Cao Jing (Surveillance Vice Commissioner); his mother was née Kong (posthumously honoured as Child Nurturer), and his stepmother is née Long (invested as Child Nurturer). Both parents (father and stepmother) are living. His elder brother is Cao Ling; his younger brothers are Cao Qian, Cao Meng, Cao Lu, and Cao Ji. He married née Cai. He ranked forty-fourth in the Yingtian Prefectural Provincial Examination and twenty-third in the Metropolitan Examination.

Hu Ying 胡英 (registered in a civilian household of Xiushui County, Jiaxing Prefecture, Zhejiang; National University Student; specialized in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); courtesy name Tingjun; first in seniority; aged forty-four, born on the twenty-sixth day of the sixth month). His great-grandfather was Hu Junzhen; his grandfather was Hu Deming; his father was Hu Lian (metropolitan graduate (jinshi)); his mother was née Wang. Both parents are deceased. His younger brothers are Hu Fang (Assistant Instructor) and Hu Fen. He married née Wu, and subsequently married née Huang. He ranked thirty-second in the Yingtian Prefectural Provincial Examination and two hundred twenty-seventh in the Metropolitan Examination.

Ren Tai 任泰 (registered in a military household of Jiashan County, Jiaxing Prefecture, Zhejiang; National University Student; specialized in the Classic of History (Shujing); courtesy name Hengbo; first in seniority; aged thirty-eight, born on the ninth day of the tenth month). His great-grandfather was Ren Zizhen; his grandfather was Ren Ziqian; his father was Ren Hai; his mother is née Dai. His mother is living. His younger brothers are Ren Jie and Ren Heng. He married née Chen. He ranked eleventh in the Zhejiang Provincial Examination and thirtieth in the Metropolitan Examination.

His younger brothers are Han Lang 朗, Han Yuan 肙 [?], Han Peng 朋, and Han Hu 瑚. He married née Li 李. His elder brother is Li Jian 鑑, and his younger brother is Li Shou 壽. He married née Yu 于. He placed twenty-second in the Henan Provincial Examination and two hundred sixteenth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Tong Zhen 佟珍 [originally from Qingzhou Prefecture 青州府, Shandong 山東, registered in a military household of Dingliao Central Guard 定遼中衛, Liaodong 遼東; a National University Student specializing in the Classic of History (Shujing 書經); courtesy name Shigui 時貴, third in seniority among his brothers, aged thirty-four, born on the twelfth day of the eleventh month]. Both parents are living; his elder brothers are Tian Jie, Tian Yun, Tian Chou [?], and Tian Zhen, and his younger brother is Tian Jun. He married née Zhang, and subsequently married née An. He placed 6th in the Henan Provincial Examination and 136th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Zheng Qi 鄭錡 (registered in Lanxi County, Jinhua Prefecture, Zhejiang, under a civilian household; National University Student; specialized in the Classic of Changes [Yijing]; courtesy name Weifu; seventh in seniority among his brothers; aged forty-eight, born on the twentieth day of the intercalary fourth month). His great-grandfather was Zheng Keyi; his grandfather was Zheng Xunjie; his father was Zheng Di (Chief Administrator); his father's first wife was née Xu; his mother is née Qiu. His mother is living; his elder brothers are Zheng Tang, Zheng Quan, Zheng Hao, Zheng Yong, Zheng Zi, and Zheng Jian, and his younger brother is Zheng Tian. He married née Wang. He placed 9th in the Zhejiang Provincial Examination and 83rd in the Metropolitan Examination.

Yu Shun 余順 (a native of Baling County, Huguang, registered in the Anqing Guard, Southern Metropolitan Area [Zhili], under a military household; National University Student; specialized in the Classic of Changes [Yijing]; courtesy name Tianzhu; first in seniority among his brothers; aged forty-one, born on the twenty-third day of the first month). His great-grandfather was Yu Jiu; his grandfather was Yu Da; his father was Yu Hai; his mother is née Zhou. His mother is living; his younger brothers are Yu Hao and Yu Yong. He married née Li. He placed 106th in the Yingtian Prefectural [Provincial] Examination and 192nd in the Metropolitan Examination.

Wu Gang 吳綱 (registered in Renhe County, Hangzhou Prefecture, Zhejiang, under a civilian household; National University Student; specialized in the Classic of Changes [Yijing]; courtesy name Tingzhen; first in seniority among his brothers; aged forty-three, born on the fifteenth day of the twelfth month). His great-grandfather was Wu Zhongxin; his grandfather was Wu Shida; his father was Wu Rong; his mother is née Zhao. His mother is living. He married née Wang. He placed 32nd in the Zhejiang Provincial Examination and 257th in the Metropolitan Examination.

His elder brothers are Zheng Kegang 鄭克剛 (Assistant Instructor), Zheng Kehe 鄭克和 (Director of a Bureau in the Ministry of Revenue), Zheng Kejing 鄭克靜, Zheng Keying 鄭克應, and Zheng Kexin 鄭克新; his younger brother is Zheng Keshi 鄭克實. His great-grandfather was Tian Bin 彬, his grandfather was Tian Jing 敬, his father was Tian Yi 益, and his mother was née Zhao 趙氏. Both of his parents are deceased. He has an elder brother, Tian Xiang 祥, and a younger brother, Tian Hu 祜. He married née Li 李氏, and took née Liu 劉氏 as his second wife. He placed 10th in the Henan Provincial Examination and 237th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Du Sheng 堵昇 [native of Shanyin County 山陰縣, Zhejiang, registered under a military household of the Embroidered-Uniform Guard (Jinyiwei 錦衣衛); Student of the Directorate of Education (Guozisheng); specialized in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); courtesy name Wenxu 文旭; first in seniority among brothers; age forty-one, born on the ninth day of the ninth month]. His great-grandfather was Du Xiangxian 祥顯, his grandfather was Du Deming 得名, his father is Du Rang 讓 [Vice Commissioner of the Crafts Institute (Wensiyuan)], his mother was née Chu 褚氏, and his stepmother is née Gao 高氏. His father and stepmother are both living. He married née Xu 徐氏. He placed 108th in the Shuntian Prefectural Provincial Examination and 124th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Shen Zhen 沈振 [native of Shanyin County 山陰縣, Shaoxing Prefecture 紹興府, Zhejiang, registered under a civilian household; Student of the Directorate of Education; specialized in the Classic of Changes (Yijing); courtesy name Kecheng 克成; fourth in seniority among brothers; age thirty-five, born on the twentieth day of the fifth month]. His great-grandfather was Shen Yanzhen 彥貞, his grandfather was Shen Ji 吉, his father is Shen Su 肅 [Prefectural Vice Prefect], and his mother is née Zhang 張氏. Both of his parents are living. He has elder brothers Shen Fan 範, Shen Yi 翼, and Shen Fu 輔, and younger brothers Shen Zuo 佐 and Shen You 佑. He married née Zhou 周氏. He placed 68th in the Zhejiang Provincial Examination and 241st in the Metropolitan Examination.

Yu Shen 俞深 [native of Xinchang County 新昌縣, Shaoxing Prefecture 紹興府, Zhejiang, registered under a civilian household; County Student; specialized in the Classic of Documents (Shujing); courtesy name Junzhi 濬之; second in seniority among brothers; age thirty-one, born on the thirtieth day of the ninth month]. His great-grandfather was Yu Yanyong 彥雍, his grandfather was Yu Shuhui 叔晦 [honored with the title of Secretary in the Ministry of Justice], his father is Yu Duo 鐸 [Right Administration Commissioner of Yunnan], and his mother is née Chen 陳氏 [honored as Lady (Furen)]. Both of his parents are living. He has an elder brother, Yu Xiang 湘, and a younger brother, Yu Pu 溥. He married née Pan 潘氏. He placed 68th in the Zhejiang Provincial Examination and 184th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Yue Huang 樂鐄 [a native of Dinghai County, Zhejiang, registered in the Imperial Academy of Medicine; National University Student; specialized in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); courtesy name Shengyuan; third in seniority among brothers; age forty-two; born on the twenty-sixth day of the first month]. He has elder brothers Xue and Ji, and is married to a woman née Liu. He placed ninth in the Shaanxi Provincial Examination and thirtieth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Qi Tinggui 齊廷珪 (registered in a military household in Longde County 隆德縣, Pingliang Prefecture 平凉府, Shaanxi 陝西; National University Student [guozisheng]; specialized in the Classic of Poetry [Shijing]; courtesy name Chaozhong 朝重; first in seniority among his brothers; aged twenty-six, born on the twenty-sixth day of the tenth month). His great-grandfather was Qi Zhuang 莊 (posthumously honoured as Subprefectural Magistrate); his grandfather was Qi Li 禮 (Prefect); his father was Qi Jing 經 (Subprefectural Magistrate); and his mother was née Zhu 朱氏. Both of his parents are living. His younger brothers are Tingzhang 廷璋, Tingxuan 廷璇, and Tingji 廷璣. He married née Yu 于氏. He ranked twenty-fourth in the Shaanxi Provincial Examination and one hundred forty-fifth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Tang Shao 唐韶 (registered in a civilian household in Changshu County 常熟縣, Suzhou Prefecture 蘇州府, Southern Metropolitan Area [Zhili 直隸]; National University Student; specialized in the Classic of History [Shujing]; courtesy name Shangyu 尚虞; third in seniority; aged twenty-eight, born on the twenty-first day of the third month). His great-grandfather was Tang Guilu 貴禄; his grandfather was Tang Wenying 文英; his father was Tang Yu 瑀; and his mothers were née Fei 費氏 and née Hu 胡氏. Both of his parents are deceased. His elder brothers are Mian 冕 (Prefectural Director of Studies) and Heng 哼 [possibly a transcription error for Xiang 亨?]; his younger brother is Yun 䪪. He married née Zhu 朱氏. He ranked one hundred thirtieth in the Yingtian Prefecture 應天府 Provincial Examination and one hundred third in the Metropolitan Examination.

Yu Ji 余鐖 (registered in an artisan household in Linhai County 臨海縣, Taizhou Prefecture 台州府, Zhejiang 浙江; National University Student; specialized in the Classic of Poetry [Shijing]; courtesy name Maoqi 懋器; fourteenth in seniority; aged thirty-six, born on the twenty-first day of the tenth month). His great-grandfather was Yu Zicheng 子誠; his grandfather was Yu Yanxin 彥信; his father was Yu Yuncao 允操; and his mother was née Zhu 朱氏. Both of his parents are deceased. His elder brother is Yi 鎰; his younger brothers are Qi 錡, Jian 鑑, Yin 銀, Yong 鏞, Keng 鏗, Yue 鈛, and Jun 鈞. He married née Zheng 鄭氏, and subsequently married née Chen 陳氏. He ranked thirty-ninth in the Zhejiang Provincial Examination and two hundred ninetieth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Liu Lun 劉綸 (registered in a civilian household in Qian Subprefecture 乾州, Xi'an Prefecture 西安府, Shaanxi 陝西; Subprefectural Student [zhouxuesheng]; specialized in the Classic of Changes [Yijing]; courtesy name Daben 大本; second in seniority; aged twenty-eight, born on the ninth day of the eighth month). His great-grandfather was Liu Zizhen 子真; his grandfather was Liu Ping 平; his father was Liu Xiang 翔 (County Director of Studies); and his mother was née Duan 段氏. His mother is living and his father is deceased. His elder brother is Jing 經. He married née Wang 王氏. He ranked forty-ninth in the Shaanxi Provincial Examination and one hundred seventy-seventh in the Metropolitan Examination.

Dong Fu 董復 (native of Kuaiji County, Shaoxing Prefecture, Zhejiang, of military registration; a National University Student specializing in the Classic of Changes (Yijing); courtesy name Dechu, seventh in his generation, aged thirty-three, born on the thirtieth day of the ninth month). His great-grandfather was Yansheng; his grandfather was Fuyan; his father was Jing, his father's former wife was née Pan, his mother was née Song, and his stepmother was née Li. Both parents are deceased. His elder brothers are Gang, Guan, Jin (Unassigned Official of the Seventh Rank), Yi, Jian, and Yu (Tribute Scholar); his younger brothers are Gen and Kai. He married née Zhang, and subsequently married née Lou. He placed fourteenth in the Zhejiang Provincial Examination and thirty-third in the Metropolitan Examination.

Yang Yu 楊鈺 (native of Jiangjin County, Chongqing Prefecture, Sichuan, of civilian registration; a National University Student specializing in the Spring and Autumn Annals (Chunqiu); courtesy name Tingxi, third in his generation, aged thirty-eight, born on the ninth day of the third month). His great-grandfather was Yan (posthumously honoured as Vice Director of a Bureau); his grandfather was Dan (posthumously honoured as Supervising Secretary); his father was Ziyuan, and his mother was née Long. Both parents are deceased. His elder brother is Ying. He married née Zhong, and subsequently married née Hu. He placed sixteenth in the Sichuan Provincial Examination and two hundred and sixty-third in the Metropolitan Examination.

Pan Long 潘隆 (native of the Datong Central Tun Guard in the Metropolitan Area [Zhili], of military registration; a National University Student specializing in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); courtesy name Fengji, fourth in his generation, aged forty, born on the twenty-eighth day of the ninth month). His great-grandfather was Yanke; his grandfather was Minxue; his father is Zhi, his mother was née Deng, and his stepmother is née Zhang. Both parents are living. His elder brothers are Chang, Yun, and Lin; his younger brothers are Wen, Rang, Wei, Feng, and Ao. He married née Cheng. He placed eighteenth in the Shuntian Prefecture Provincial Examination and one hundred and ninety-seventh in the Metropolitan Examination.

Wei Zhang 魏璋 (native of Yanling County, Kaifeng Prefecture, Henan, of civilian registration; a National University Student specializing in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); courtesy name Tinggui, first in his generation, aged thirty-three, born on the fifth day of the third month). His great-grandfather was Wenzuo (Police Chief); his grandfather was Li; his father is Rong, his legal mother is née Sun, and his birth mother is née Li. Both parents are living. His younger brother is Huang. He married née Li. He placed sixty-eighth in the Henan Provincial Examination and forty-seventh in the Metropolitan Examination.

陳經〔貫湖廣衡州府桂陽州臨武縣軍籍，國子生，治《易經》，字貫之，行四，年三十三，五月初一日生〕。曾祖舜相〔訓導〕，祖侶瑩，父壽鼎〔教諭〕，母劉氏。慈侍下。兄綱、禎、權，弟綺、徽、紳。娶黃氏。湖廣鄉試第八十名，會試第四十四名。

張鼎〔貫河南信陽縣人，府軍衛官籍，京衛武學生，治《書經》，字宗器，行一，年三十，二月十六日生〕。曾祖道〔贈指揮同知〕，祖林〔贈指揮同知〕，父賢〔指揮同知〕，〔母枚氏，封淑人；妻江氏〕。永感下。弟鼐、鼒。順天府鄉試第二十二名，會試第八十四名。

孔斌〔貫浙江蕭山縣人，遼東廣寧中屯衛旗籍，國子生，治《詩經》，字時憲，行三，年三十七，十月二十六日生〕。曾祖惠，祖本初，父孟寧，母厲氏，生母黃氏。具慶下。兄汝、文、丈。娶羅氏。順天府鄉試第六十六名，會試第一百五十五名。

張宏〔貫順天府大興縣人，龍驤衛官籍，國子生，治《詩經》，字克容，行一，年三十四，十一月二十九日生〕。曾祖七功，祖禮，父信〔百戶〕，母姚氏。永感下。弟寧、定。娶高氏。順天府鄉試第七十八名，會試第一百三十三名。
translation_en:
Chen Jing 陳經: Registered in a military household in Linwu County, Guiyang Subprefecture, Hengzhou Prefecture, Huguang; a student of the Directorate of Education (Guozisheng), specializing in the Classic of Changes (Yijing). His courtesy name is Guanzhi, he is the fourth son in his generation, aged thirty-three, born on the first day of the fifth month. His great-grandfather was Chen Shunxiang (Assistant Instructor), his grandfather was Chen Lüying, his father was Chen Shouding (Instructor), and his mother is née Liu. His mother is living while his father is deceased. His elder brothers are Chen Gang, Chen Zhen, and Chen Quan; his younger brothers are Chen Qi, Chen Hui, and Chen Shen. He married née Huang. He placed 80th in the Huguang Provincial Examination and 44th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Zhang Ding 張鼎: A native of Xinyang County, Henan, registered in an officer household of the Chief Military Commission Guard (Fujun Wei); a student of the Capital Guards Military School (Jingwei Wuxuesheng), specializing in the Classic of Documents (Shujing). His courtesy name is Zongqi, he is the first son in his generation, aged thirty, born on the sixteenth day of the second month. His great-grandfather was Zhang Dao (posthumously honoured as Vice Commander), his grandfather was Zhang Lin (posthumously honoured as Vice Commander), his father was Zhang Xian (Vice Commander), his mother was née Mei (invested as Lady of Virtue), and his wife is née Jiang. Both of his parents are deceased. His younger brothers are Zhang Nai and Zhang Zi. He placed 22nd in the Shuntian Prefecture Provincial Examination and 84th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Kong Bin 孔斌: A native of Xiaoshan County, Zhejiang, registered in a bannerman/military household of the Guangning Central Tun Guard in Liaodong; a student of the Directorate of Education (Guozisheng), specializing in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing). His courtesy name is Shixian, he is the third son in his generation, aged thirty-seven, born on the twenty-sixth day of the tenth month. His great-grandfather was Kong Hui, his grandfather was Kong Benchu, his father is Kong Mengning, his legal mother is née Li, and his birth mother is née Huang. Both of his parents are living. His elder brothers are Kong Ru, Kong Wen, and Kong Zhang [?]. He married née Luo. He placed 66th in the Shuntian Prefecture Provincial Examination and 155th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Zhang Hong 張宏: A native of Daxing County, Shuntian Prefecture, registered in an officer household of the Longxiang Guard; a student of the Directorate of Education (Guozisheng), specializing in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing). His courtesy name is Kerong, he is the first son in his generation, aged thirty-four, born on the twenty-ninth day of the eleventh month. His great-grandfather was Zhang Qigong, his grandfather was Zhang Li, his father was Zhang Xin (Company Commander), and his mother was née Yao. Both of his parents are deceased. His younger brothers are Zhang Ning and Zhang Ding. He married née Gao. He placed 78th in the Shuntian Prefecture Provincial Examination and 133rd in the Metropolitan Examination.

punctuated:
林淮〔貫福建興化府莆田縣，軍籍，府學生，治《書經》，字長深，行一，年三十五，八月十五日生〕。曾祖觀，祖森，父榕，母蕭氏。慈侍下。娶郭氏，繼娶黃氏。福建鄉試第六名，會試第九十名。
鄭欽〔貫福建興化府莆田縣，軍籍，儒士，治《書經》，字尚敬，行一，年四十二，六月初二日生〕。曾祖大臻，祖士團，父玉輝，母唐氏。具慶下。弟讓、誼、譁，娶俞氏，繼娶詹氏。福建鄉試第五十四名，會試第二百五十一名。
劉信〔貫四川敘州府南溪縣，民籍，縣學增廣生，治《易經》，字朋節，行六，年三十二，十月初六日生〕。曾祖永壽〔同知〕，祖琬，父恂〔教授〕，前母郭氏、王氏、熊氏，母張氏。永感下。兄廣、本、文、廓、忠〔同科進士〕，娶胡氏。四川鄉試第十名，會試第一百一名。
李楫〔貫福建汀州府上杭縣，匠籍，國子生，治《易經》，字時濟，行三，年四十，九月初七日生〕。曾祖子雲，祖勝保，父通，母陳氏，繼母謝氏。具慶下。兄時中、時英，弟時富、時貴、時茂、時發，娶黃氏。福建鄉試第三十名，會試第二百九十一名。
translation_en:
Lin Huai 林淮 [registered in Putian County 莆田縣, Xinghua Prefecture 興化府, Fujian 福建, under a military household (junji 軍籍); a Prefectural Student (fuxue sheng 府學生) specializing in the Classic of History (Shujing 書經); courtesy name Changshen 長深; first in seniority among his brothers; aged thirty-five, born on the fifteenth day of the eighth month]. His great-grandfather was Lin Guan 林觀, his grandfather was Lin Sen 林森, his father was Lin Rong 林榕, and his mother is née Xiao 蕭氏. His mother is living and his father is deceased (cishi xia 慈侍下). He married née Guo 郭氏, and subsequently married née Huang 黃氏. He placed sixth in the Fujian Provincial Examination and ninetieth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Zheng Qin 鄭欽 [registered in Putian County, Xinghua Prefecture, Fujian, under a military household; a Confucian Scholar (rushi 儒士) specializing in the Classic of History; courtesy name Shangjing 尚敬; first in seniority among his brothers; aged forty-two, born on the second day of the sixth month]. His great-grandfather was Zheng Dazhen 鄭大臻, his grandfather was Zheng Shituan 鄭士團, his father is Zheng Yuhui 鄭玉輝, and his mother is née Tang 唐氏. Both of his parents are living (juqing xia 具慶下). His younger brothers are Zheng Rang 鄭讓, Zheng Yi 鄭誼, and Zheng Hua 鄭譁; he married née Yu 俞氏, and subsequently married née Zhan 詹氏. He placed fifty-fourth in the Fujian Provincial Examination and two hundred fifty-first in the Metropolitan Examination.

Liu Xin 劉信 [registered in Nanxi County 南溪縣, Xuzhou Prefecture 敘州府, Sichuan 四川, under a civilian household (minji 民籍); an Added Student of the County School (xianxue zengguang sheng 縣學增廣生) specializing in the Classic of Changes (Yijing 易經); courtesy name Pengjie 朋節; sixth in seniority among his brothers; aged thirty-two, born on the sixth day of the tenth month]. His great-grandfather was Liu Yongshou 劉永壽 [Vice Prefect (tongzhi 同知)], his grandfather was Liu Wan 劉琬, his father was Liu Xun 劉恂 [Instructor (jiaoshou 教授)], his father's former wives were née Guo 郭氏, née Wang 王氏, and née Xiong 熊氏, and his mother was née Zhang 張氏. Both of his parents are deceased (yonggan xia 永感下). His elder brothers are Liu Guang 劉廣, Liu Ben 劉本, Liu Wen 劉文, Liu Kuo 劉廓, and Liu Zhong 劉忠 [metropolitan graduate of the same examination year]; he married née Hu 胡氏. He placed tenth in the Sichuan Provincial Examination and one hundred first in the Metropolitan Examination.

Li Ji 李楫 [registered in Shanghang County 上杭縣, Tingzhou Prefecture 汀州府, Fujian, under an artisan household (jiangji 匠籍); a Directorate Student (guozi sheng 國子生) specializing in the Classic of Changes; courtesy name Shiji 時濟; third in seniority among his brothers; aged forty, born on the seventh day of the ninth month]. His great-grandfather was Li Ziyun 李子雲, his grandfather was Li Shengbao 李勝保, his father is Li Tong 李通, his mother was née Chen 陳氏, and his stepmother is née Xie 謝氏. Both his father and stepmother are living (juqing xia 具慶下). His elder brothers are Li Shizhong 李時中 and Li Shiying 李時英; his younger brothers are Li Shifu 李時富, Li Shigui 李時貴, Li Shimao 李時茂, and Li Shifa 李時發; he married née Huang 黃氏. He placed thirtieth in the Fujian Provincial Examination and two hundred ninety-first in the Metropolitan Examination.

translation_en:
Chen Xiang 陳祥 [originally from Jian'an County, Fujian, registered under a military household in the Ganzhou Central Escort Guard; a Directorate Student specializing in the Classic of Changes (Yijing); courtesy name Jifu, second in seniority among his brothers, aged thirty-three, born on the twelfth day of the twelfth month]. His great-grandfather was Chen Ji, his grandfather Chen An, his father Chen Yu, and his mother née Wu. Both his parents are deceased. His elder brother is Chen Zhen, and he is married to née Ren. He placed first in the Shaanxi Provincial Examination and two hundred ninety-ninth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Xie Fuyang 謝富陽 [originally from Jishui County, Jiangxi, registered under a civilian household in Ruijin County, Ganzhou Prefecture; a County Student specializing in the Classic of History (Shujing); courtesy name Shichun, second in seniority among his brothers, aged forty-two, born on the twenty-seventh day of the fourth month]. His great-grandfather was Xie Jing, his grandfather Xie Qian, his father Xie Zhuo [Instructor], and his mother née Liu. Both his parents are deceased. His elder brother is Xie Yongyang, and his younger brothers are Xie Chenyang and Xie Wuyang. He is married to née Li. He placed ninety-second in the Jiangxi Provincial Examination and ninety-fourth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Zhou Mu 周木 [registered under a civilian household in Changshu County, Suzhou Prefecture, Southern Metropolitan Area (Zhili); an Added Student of the county school specializing in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); courtesy name Jinren, first in seniority among his brothers, aged twenty-nine, born on the twelfth day of the seventh month]. His great-grandfather was Zhou Jixin, his grandfather Zhou Yijing, his father Zhou Shiwang, and his mother née Gu. His father is living and his mother is deceased. His younger brothers are Zhou Bin, Zhou Kai [Tribute Student (gongshi)], Zhou Yingxiang, Zhou Sen, Zhou Ge, Zhou Gan, and Zhou Zhu. He is married to née Chen. He placed thirtieth in the Yingtian Prefectural Provincial Examination and two hundred ninety-fifth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Guo Zhi 郭秩 [originally from Wan'an County, Ji'an Prefecture, Jiangxi, registered under a civilian household in Taihe County; a Directorate Student specializing in the Classic of Changes (Yijing); courtesy name Chilun, first in seniority among his brothers, aged thirty-nine, born on the fourteenth day of the third month]. His great-grandfather was Guo Jinzhang, his grandfather Guo Boqian, his father Guo Liangqing, and his mother née Xie. Both his parents are deceased. His younger brothers are Guo Chijing, Guo Ji [Expectant Official (tingxuan guan)], and Guo Chijian. He is married to née Ouyang. He placed twelfth in the Jiangxi Provincial Examination and two hundred ninth in the Metropolitan Examination.

His younger brothers are Zan 禶 and Yi 禕. He married Lady Tao 陶氏, and later married Lady Yao 姚氏. His great-grandfather was Yida 以達, his grandfather was Deming 德明 (Investigating Censor), his father is Tizhong 體忠, and his mother is Lady Huang 黄氏. Both parents are living. His younger brother is Xu 煦. He married Lady Yang 楊氏. He ranked 76th in the Fujian Provincial Examination and 179th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Li Jing 黎經 (registered in a civilian household of Yangshuo County 陽朔縣, Guilin Prefecture 桂林府, Guangxi 廣西; National University Student; specialized in the Record of Rites (Liji); courtesy name Yunzheng 允正; third in his generation; age twenty-eight, born on the twentieth day of the seventh month). His great-grandfather was Bingliang 秉良, his grandfather was Congxue 從學, his father is Yuheng 與衡, and his mother is Lady Qin 秦氏. Both parents are living. His elder brothers are Fu 福 and Xi 禧 (Tribute Student), and his younger brothers are Shao 紹, Shou 綬, Shen 紳, Chun 純, and Lun 綸. He married Lady Li 李氏. He ranked 22nd in the Guangxi Provincial Examination and 269th in the Metropolitan Examination.

His younger brothers are He Heng and He Cui, and he married née Pan. He placed 10th in the Guangdong Provincial Examination and 209th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Lu Yu 陸愈 [registered in a saltern household in Pinghu County, Jiaxing Prefecture, Zhejiang; National University Student; specialized in the Classic of History (Shujing); courtesy name Yizhi; second in seniority among his brothers; aged thirty-seven; born on the twelfth day of the seventh month]. His great-grandfather was Lu Shirong, his grandfather is Lu Cheng, his father is Lu Gui, and his mother is née Zhu. Both grandparents and parents are living. His elder brother is Lu Mao, his younger brother is Lu Zhi, and he married née Wu. He placed 35th in the Zhejiang Provincial Examination and 219th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Chen Ju 陳琚 [registered in a military household in Queshan County, Runing Prefecture, Henan; National University Student; specialized in the Record of Rites (Liji); courtesy name Zongyu; first in seniority among his brothers; aged thirty-five; born on the seventeenth day of the eighth month]. His great-grandfather was Chen You, his grandfather was Chen Jing, his father is Chen Qi, and his mother is née Wang. Both parents are living. His younger brothers are Chen Huang and Chen Zan, and he married née Li. He placed 29th in the Henan Provincial Examination and 210th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Zhou Hong 周洪 [registered in a military household in Wucheng County, Gaotang Subprefecture, Dongchang Prefecture, Shandong; National University Student; specialized in the Classic of Changes (Yijing); courtesy name Kuanfu; second in seniority among his brothers; aged thirty-six; born on the nineteenth day of the eleventh month]. His great-grandfather was Zhou Defu, his grandfather was Zhou Shiyuan, his father was Zhou Sheng [National University Student], and his mother is née Guo. His mother is living. His elder brother is Zhou Hao [Assistant Instructor of the Medical School], and his younger brothers are Zhou Pu and Zhou Han. He married née Wang, and remarried née Zhang. He placed 43rd in the Shandong Provincial Examination and 196th in the Metropolitan Examination.

translation_en:
Wang Fu 王傅 [registered in Baodi County 寶坻縣, Tongzhou 通州, Shuntian Prefecture 順天府, under military household status; a student of the Directorate of Education (Guozisheng) specializing in the Spring and Autumn Annals (Chunqiu); style name Shunchen 舜臣; first in seniority among brothers; aged twenty-seven, born on the twenty-third day of the ninth month]. His great-grandfather was Wang Fuqing 福慶; his grandfather was Wang Ning 寧 [Jail Warden (Siyu)]; his father is Wang Jin 縉 [Official Awaiting Appointment (Tingxuan guan)]; and his mother is née Zhao 趙氏. Both of his parents are living. His younger brothers are Wang Lun 倫, Wang Kan 侃, Wang Bao 保, Wang Xiu 修, and Wang Ti 倜. He married née Liu 劉氏. He placed 108th in the Shuntian Prefectural Provincial Examination and 271st in the Metropolitan Examination.

Sun Bin 孫賓 [native of Jiaohe County 交河縣 in the Metropolitan Area (Zhili 直隸), registered as a military artisan in the Embroidered-Uniform Guard (Jinyiwei); a student of the Directorate of Education specializing in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); style name Jingzhi 敬之; first in seniority among brothers; aged twenty-six, born on the eighth day of the eleventh month]. His great-grandfather was Sun Cheng 成; his grandfather was Sun Li 禮; his father is Sun Xuan 宣; and his mother is née Zhou 周氏. Both of his parents are living. He married née Wang 王氏. He placed 92nd in the Shuntian Prefectural Provincial Examination and 204th in the Metropolitan Examination.

He Shan 何善 [registered in Xingan County 新淦縣, Linjiang Prefecture 臨江府, Jiangxi 江西, under civilian household status; a student of the Directorate of Education specializing in the Classic of Poetry; style name Weiji 惟吉; third in seniority among brothers; aged forty-three, born on the twenty-third day of the ninth month]. His great-grandfather was He Wurong 務榮; his grandfather was He Zichong 自充; his father is He Zhen 貞 [Instructor (Jiaoshou), honoured with the title of Vice Director in the Ministry of Justice (Xingbu yuanwailang)]; and his mother was née Tu 凃氏 [honoured as Lady of Suitability (Yiren)]. His father is living. His elder brothers are He Xian 賢 and He Zhong 衷 [Right Assistant Minister of the Court of Judicial Review in Nanjing (Nanjing Dalisi you sicheng)]; his younger brothers are He Chun 純 [Investigating Censor (Jiancha yushi)], He Jing 敬, He Liang 良, He Neng 能, and He Zhe 哲. He married née Liu 劉氏, and subsequently married née Rao 饒氏. He placed 72nd in the Jiangxi Provincial Examination and 275th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Li Siming 李思明 [registered in Jining Subprefecture 濟寧州, Yanzhou Prefecture 兗州府, Shandong 山東, under military household status; a subprefectural student (zhou xuesheng) specializing in the Classic of Poetry; style name Yuanhui 原晦; first in seniority among brothers; aged twenty-four, born on the twenty-first day of the ninth month]. His great-grandfather was Li Youshen 友莘; his grandfather was Li Jingxian 敬先; his father is Li Kai 鎧 [tribute student (Gongshi)]; his mother was née Ma 馬氏, and his stepmother is née Zang 臧氏. His father and stepmother are both living. His younger brother is Li Sicong 思聰. He married née Zhao 趙氏, and is subsequently betrothed to née Liang 梁氏. He placed 38th in the Shandong Provincial Examination and 106th in the Metropolitan Examination.

蹇霆〔貫四川重慶府巴縣官籍，國子生，治《禮記》，字克遂，行一，年四十，十月初六日生〕。曾祖源斌〔贈榮祿大夫、少師、吏部尚書〕；祖義〔榮祿大夫、少師兼吏部尚書，贈特進光祿大夫、太師，謚忠定〕；父芸〔國子生〕；母龐氏。永感下。弟霦、霪、霓。娶尹氏。四川鄉試第十名，會試第二百七十四名。

黃乾亨〔貫福建興化府莆田縣民籍，府學生，治《詩經》，字汝亨，行二，年二十七，五月初十日生〕。曾祖壽生〔翰林院檢討，贈知縣〕；祖子嘉〔知縣，進階文林郎〕；父深〔監察御史〕；母林氏。重慶下。兄乾元，弟乾剛、乾正、乾清。娶林氏。福建鄉試第一名，會試第二百六十一名。

宋德〔貫陝西鳳翔府岐山縣民籍，國子生，治《詩經》，字世隆，行三，年四十，十二月初六日生〕。曾祖克敬；祖禮；父秉彛；母朱氏。慈侍下。兄性、瓚〔國子生〕。娶李氏。陝西鄉試第六十二名，會試第二百五十六名。

錢承德〔貫直隸蘇州府常熟縣民籍，國子生，治《詩經》，字世恒，行一，年二十八，十一月十六日生〕。曾祖中得；祖汝周〔義官〕；父允言〔承事郎〕；嫡母葉氏、連氏，生母查氏。具慶下。弟承芳、承恩。娶桑氏。應天府鄉試第七十八名，會試第二百四十三名。
translation_en:
Jian Ting 蹇霆 [registered under official household status in Ba County 巴縣, Chongqing Prefecture 重慶府, Sichuan 四川; a National University Student (國子生) specializing in the Record of Rites (禮記); courtesy name Kesui 克遂; first in seniority among brothers; aged forty, born on the sixth day of the tenth month]. His great-grandfather was Jian Yuanbin 源斌 [posthumously honored as Grandee of the First Class (榮祿大夫), Junior Preceptor (少師), and Minister of Personnel (吏部尚書)]; his grandfather was Jian Yi 義 [Grandee of the First Class, Junior Preceptor concurrently serving as Minister of Personnel, posthumously honored as Specially Promoted Grandee of the First Class (特進光祿大夫) and Grand Preceptor (太師), with the posthumous title Zhongding 忠定]; his father was Jian Yun 芸 [National University Student]; and his mother was née Pang 龐氏. Both parents are deceased (永感下). His younger brothers are Jian Bin 霦, Jian Yin 霪, and Jian Ni 霓. He married née Yin 尹氏. He placed tenth in the Sichuan Provincial Examination and two hundred seventy-fourth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Huang Qianheng 黃乾亨 [registered under civilian household status in Putian County 莆田縣, Xinghua Prefecture 興化府, Fujian 福建; a Prefectural Student (府學生) specializing in the Classic of Poetry (詩經); courtesy name Ruheng 汝亨; second in seniority among brothers; aged twenty-seven, born on the tenth day of the fifth month]. His great-grandfather was Huang Shousheng 壽生 [Examining Editor in the Hanlin Academy (翰林院檢討), posthumously honored as District Magistrate (知縣)]; his grandfather was Huang Zijia 子嘉 [District Magistrate, advanced in prestige title to Gentleman for Fostering Literature (文林郎)]; his father is Huang Shen 深 [Investigating Censor (監察御史)]; and his mother is née Lin 林氏. His parents and grandparents are living (重慶下). His elder brother is Huang Qianyuan 乾元, and his younger brothers are Huang Qiangang 乾剛, Huang Qianzheng 乾正, and Huang Qianqing 乾清. He married née Lin 林氏. He placed first in the Fujian Provincial Examination and two hundred sixty-first in the Metropolitan Examination.

Song De 宋德 [registered under civilian household status in Qishan County 岐山縣, Fengxiang Prefecture 鳳翔府, Shaanxi 陝西; a National University Student specializing in the Classic of Poetry; courtesy name Shilong 世隆; third in seniority among brothers; aged forty, born on the sixth day of the twelfth month]. His great-grandfather was Song Kejing 克敬; his grandfather was Song Li 禮; his father was Song Bingyi 秉彛; and his mother is née Zhu 朱氏. His mother is living (慈侍下). His elder brothers are Song Xing 性 and Song Zan 瓚 [National University Student]. He married née Li 李氏. He placed sixty-second in the Shaanxi Provincial Examination and two hundred fifty-sixth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Qian Chengde 錢承德 [registered under civilian household status in Changshu County 常熟縣, Suzhou Prefecture 蘇州府, Southern Metropolitan Area (直隸); a National University Student specializing in the Classic of Poetry; courtesy name Shiheng 世恒; first in seniority among brothers; aged twenty-eight, born on the sixteenth day of the eleventh month]. His great-grandfather was Qian Zhongde 中得; his grandfather was Qian Ruzhou 汝周 [Righteous Official (義官)]; his father is Qian Yunyan 允言 [Gentleman for Managing Affairs (承事郎)]; his legal mothers were née Ye 葉氏 and née Lian 連氏, and his birth mother is née Cha 查氏. Both parents are living (具慶下). His younger brothers are Qian Chengfang 承芳 and Qian Cheng'en 承恩. He married née Sang 桑氏. He placed seventy-eighth in the Yingtian Prefectural (應天府) Provincial Examination and two hundred forty-third in the Metropolitan Examination.

李行〔貫江西臨江府新喻縣軍籍，國子生，治《詩經》，字遵化，行四，年四十一，九月初五日生〕。曾祖泓真；祖政子；父不言，母温氏。慈侍下。兄遵、學、典，弟軾、轍。娶劉氏。江西鄉試第十一名，會試第一百四名。

translation_en:
Hua Zhongxian 華仲賢 (registered in a military household in Qizhou 蘄州, Huangzhou Prefecture 黃州府, Huguang 湖廣; a National University Student specializing in the Classic of History (Shujing); courtesy name Tingzuo 廷佐; first in seniority among his brothers; aged thirty-seven, born on the fifteenth day of the sixth month). His great-grandfather was Hua Wenyu 華文郁 (Longevity Official); his grandfather is Hua Jing 華敬; his father is Hua Jue 華玨, and his mother is née Chen 陳. Both his grandparents and parents are living. His younger brothers are Hua Zhongcheng 華仲誠 and Hua Zhongwen 華仲文. He married née Chen 陳. He placed 75th in the Huguang Provincial Examination and 146th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Hu Ying 胡瀛 (registered in a civilian household in Luoshan County 羅山縣, Runing Prefecture 汝寧府, Henan 河南; a National University Student specializing in the Spring and Autumn Annals (Chunqiu); courtesy name Mengdeng 孟登; second in seniority among his brothers; aged thirty-two, born on the eighteenth day of the first month). His great-grandfather was Hu Tongli 胡通禮; his grandfather was Hu Mingyuan 胡名遠; his father is Hu Dequan 胡得泉, his father's former wife was née Zhu 朱, and his mother is née Xiong 熊. Both his parents are living. His elder brother is Hu Shen 胡深. He married née Wang 王. He placed 7th in the Henan Provincial Examination and 212th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Li Xing 李行 (registered in a military household in Xinyu County 新喻縣, Linjiang Prefecture 臨江府, Jiangxi 江西; a National University Student specializing in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); courtesy name Zunhua 遵化; fourth in seniority among his brothers; aged forty-one, born on the fifth day of the ninth month). His great-grandfather was Li Hongzhen 李泓真; his grandfather was Li Zhengzi 李政子; his father was Li Buyan 李不言, and his mother is née Wen 温. His mother is living. His elder brothers are Li Zun 李遵, Li Xue 李學, and Li Dian 李典, and his younger brothers are Li Shi 李軾 and Li Zhe 李轍. He married née Liu 劉. He placed 11th in the Jiangxi Provincial Examination and 104th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Li Min 李旻 (a native of Zhaozhou 趙州, Zhending Prefecture 真定府, Zhili 直隸, serving as a Squad Leader in the Embroidered-Uniform Guard; specializing in the Classic of Changes (Yijing); courtesy name Renfu 仁甫; third in seniority among his brothers; aged thirty-one, born on the twenty-eighth day of the tenth month). His great-grandfather was Li Cheng 李成; his grandfather was Li Fusheng 李福盛; his father is Li Shun 李順, and his mother is née Lu 陸. Both his parents are living. His elder brothers are Li Guang 李廣 and Li Jian 李鑑, and his younger brothers are Li Ang 李昂, Li Gao 李杲, and Li Xian 李暹. He is betrothed to née Mao 茅. He placed 34th in the Shuntian Prefectural Provincial Examination and 130th in the Metropolitan Examination.

He is married to a woman née Zhou. He placed twenty-ninth in the Huguang Provincial Examination and two hundred forty-sixth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Xiang Rong 向榮 [registered in a civilian household in Jinxian County, Nanchang Prefecture, Jiangxi; National University Student; specialized in the Classic of Documents (Shujing); courtesy name Zhide; first in seniority among his brothers; aged thirty-five; born on the sixteenth day of the ninth month]. His great-grandfather was Xiang Daolong; his grandfather was Xiang Keming; his father is Xiang Yijie; his mother is née Rao. Both his grandparents and parents are living. Zhu Hong 朱洪 [registered in a military household in Guide Subprefecture, Kaifeng Prefecture, Henan; National University Student; specialized in the Classic of Documents (Shujing); courtesy name Zonghai; fourth in seniority among his brothers; aged thirty-eight; born on the seventeenth day of the twelfth month]. His elder brothers are Zhu Yuan, Zhu Qing, and Zhu Hao. He is married to a woman née Liu. He placed second in the Henan Provincial Examination and one hundred sixty-third in the Metropolitan Examination.

閻仲宇〔貫陝西鳳翔府隴州軍籍，州學生，治《易經》，字參甫，行三，年三十五，閏十月二十七日生〕。曾祖才順，祖秀，父璿〔教諭，贈吏部主事〕，母王氏〔贈安人〕。永感下。兄仲寬、仲實〔吏部主事〕，弟仲容、仲寅、仲賓、仲宏、仲寧。娶仲氏。陝西鄉試第三名，會試第二百六十五名。

郭珙〔貫福建福州府閩縣民籍，國子生，治《易經》，字元圭，行五，年四十，十月初一日生〕。曾祖崇〔教諭〕，祖福，父嶽，前母包氏，母李氏，繼母趙氏。嚴侍下。兄璁，弟璉、珩、琚。娶吳氏。福建鄉試第十二名，會試第六十七名。

translation_en:
Ji Jie 紀傑 [registered under a civilian household in Cizhou 磁州, Zhangde Prefecture 彰德府, Henan 河南; a Subprefectural Student specializing in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); courtesy name Shiying 士英; third in seniority among his brothers; aged thirty-four, born on the twentieth day of the ninth month]. His great-grandfather was Ji Wang 旺, his grandfather was Ji Lin 麟, his father was Ji Can 驂, and his mother was Lady Li 李氏. Both of his parents are deceased. His elder brothers are Ji Xin 信 and Ji Jun 俊, and his younger brother is Ji Fu 傅. He married Lady Li 李氏. He ranked sixtieth in the Henan Provincial Examination and two hundred and twentieth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Yan Zhongyu 閻仲宇 [registered under a military household in Longzhou 隴州, Fengxiang Prefecture 鳳翔府, Shaanxi 陝西; a Subprefectural Student specializing in the Classic of Changes (Yijing); courtesy name Canfu 參甫; third in seniority among his brothers; aged thirty-five, born on the twenty-seventh day of the intercalary tenth month]. His great-grandfather was Yan Caishun 才順, his grandfather was Yan Xiu 秀, his father was Yan Xuan 璿 [Instructor, posthumously honoured as Secretary in the Ministry of Personnel], and his mother was Lady Wang 王氏 [posthumously honoured as Lady of Serenity (Anren)]. Both of his parents are deceased. His elder brothers are Yan Zhongkuan 仲寬 and Yan Zhongshi 仲實 [Secretary in the Ministry of Personnel], and his younger brothers are Yan Zhongrong 仲容, Yan Zhongyin 仲寅, Yan Zhongbin 仲賓, Yan Zhonghong 仲宏, and Yan Zhongning 仲寧. He married Lady Zhong 仲氏. He ranked third in the Shaanxi Provincial Examination and two hundred and sixty-fifth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Guo Gong 郭珙 [registered under a civilian household in Min County 閩縣, Fuzhou Prefecture 福州府, Fujian 福建; a Student of the Directorate of Education (Guozisheng) specializing in the Classic of Changes (Yijing); courtesy name Yuangui 元圭; fifth in seniority among his brothers; aged forty, born on the first day of the tenth month]. His great-grandfather was Guo Chong 崇 [Instructor], his grandfather was Guo Fu 福, his father is Guo Yue 嶽, his father's former wife was Lady Bao 包氏, his mother was Lady Li 李氏, and his stepmother is Lady Zhao 趙氏. His father is living and his mother is deceased. His elder brother is Guo Cong 璁, and his younger brothers are Guo Lian 璉, Guo Heng 珩, and Guo Ju 琚. He married Lady Wu 吳氏. He ranked twelfth in the Fujian Provincial Examination and sixty-seventh in the Metropolitan Examination.

Chen Huan 陳奐 [registered under a civilian household in Zhangpu County 漳浦縣, Zhangzhou Prefecture 漳州府, Fujian 福建; a Student of the Directorate of Education (Guozisheng) specializing in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); courtesy name Chaomei 朝美; first in seniority among his brothers; aged forty-one, born on the eighth day of the fifth month]. His great-grandfather was Chen Zeyi 則彛 [posthumously honoured as Director in the Ministry of Personnel], his grandfather was Chen Yi 翼 [Tribute Student (Gongshi)], his father is Chen Zhen 貞, his mother was Lady Zhou 周氏, and his stepmothers were Lady Xie 謝氏 and Lady Wang 王氏. His father and stepmother are both living. His younger brothers are Chen Bing 炳 and Chen Lang 烺. He married Lady Lin 林氏, and subsequently married Lady Yan 顏氏. He ranked seventy-fourth in the Fujian Provincial Examination and seventy-fifth in the Metropolitan Examination.

His great-grandfather was Liang; his grandfather was Shan; his father was An (Philanthropic Official), his father's former wives were née Du and née Yu, and his mother was née Xue. Both of his parents are deceased. His younger brothers are Shu and Mao. He married née Kong. He ranked 23rd in the Shandong Provincial Examination and 118th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Yan Jing 顏涇: Registered in a civilian household of Wu County, Suzhou Prefecture, Southern Metropolitan Area (Zhili); a National University Student (guozisheng) specializing in the Classic of Documents (Shujing); courtesy name Chengzhi, first in seniority, aged thirty-five, born on the seventeenth day of the intercalary eleventh month. Fang Zhi 方陟: Registered in a civilian household of Hefei County, Luzhou Prefecture, Southern Metropolitan Area (Zhili); a National University Student (guozisheng) specializing in the Classic of Documents (Shujing); courtesy name Wenjin, fifth in seniority, aged thirty-four, born on the twelfth day of the ninth month. He married née Zheng, and remarried née Liu. He ranked 80th in the Yingtian Prefecture Provincial Examination and 225th in the Metropolitan Examination.

李琨〔貫直隸常州府江陰縣軍籍，國子生，治《書經》，字德嘉，行三，年四十，六月十三日生〕。曾祖英〔知事〕，祖如本，父惟吉，母徐氏。永感下，兄暉、暄，弟春、暕、昺，娶沈氏。應天府鄉試第二十六名，會試第七十八名。
趙年〔貫浙江金華府湯溪縣軍籍，蘭谿縣學生，治《易經》，字有年，行十二，年三十，九月二十六日生〕。曾祖文慧，祖良蕘，父時敏，母華氏。重慶下，兄賽，弟貫、貴、實、瀛、贊，娶潘氏。浙江鄉試第四十名，會試第一百八十三名。
湯鼐〔貫應天府句容縣民籍，壽州學生，治《春秋》，字用之，行三，年三十二，閏七月十六日生〕。曾祖順一，祖應善，父彥和，母馮氏。具慶下，兄盤、鼎，弟輅，娶張氏。應天府鄉試第五名，會試第七十九名。
translation_en:
Zhang Zan 張瓚 [registered in a military household of Wugong Central Guard, an Added Student of the Shuntian Prefectural School, specialized in the Book of Documents (Shujing), courtesy name Qizhi, third in seniority among his brothers, aged twenty-eight, born on the fourth day of the sixth month]. His great-grandfather was Zhang Yanzhen, his grandfather was Zhang Shixuan, his father was Zhang Bocheng, his father's former wife was née Guo, and his mother was née Zhao. Both parents are living; his elder brothers are Zhang Yu and Zhang Jing, his younger brother is Zhang Qi, and he married née Zhang. He placed 73rd in the Shuntian Prefectural Provincial Examination and 222nd in the Metropolitan Examination.

Li Kun 李琨 [registered in a military household of Jiangyin County, Changzhou Prefecture, Southern Metropolitan Area (Zhili), a National University Student, specialized in the Book of Documents (Shujing), courtesy name Dejia, third in seniority among his brothers, aged forty, born on the thirteenth day of the sixth month]. His great-grandfather was Li Ying [Administrative Clerk], his grandfather was Li Ruben, his father was Li Weiji, and his mother was née Xu. Both parents are deceased; his elder brothers are Li Hui and Li Xuan, his younger brothers are Li Chun, Li Jian, and Li Bing, and he married née Shen. He placed 26th in the Yingtian Prefectural Provincial Examination and 78th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Zhao Nian 趙年 [registered in a military household of Tangxi County, Jinhua Prefecture, Zhejiang, a student of the Lanxi County School, specialized in the Book of Changes (Yijing), courtesy name Younian, twelfth in seniority among his brothers and cousins, aged thirty, born on the twenty-sixth day of the ninth month]. His great-grandfather was Zhao Wenhui, his grandfather was Zhao Liangrao, his father was Zhao Shimin, and his mother was née Hua. Both his parents and grandparents are living; his elder brother is Zhao Sai, his younger brothers are Zhao Guan, Zhao Gui, Zhao Shi, Zhao Ying, and Zhao Zan, and he married née Pan. He placed 40th in the Zhejiang Provincial Examination and 183rd in the Metropolitan Examination.

Tang Nai 湯鼐 [registered in a civilian household of Jurong County, Yingtian Prefecture, a student of the Shouzhou Subprefectural School, specialized in the Spring and Autumn Annals (Chunqiu), courtesy name Yongzhi, third in seniority among his brothers, aged thirty-two, born on the sixteenth day of the intercalary seventh month]. His great-grandfather was Tang Shunyi, his grandfather was Tang Yingshan, his father was Tang Yanhe, and his mother was née Feng. Both parents are living; his elder brothers are Tang Pan and Tang Ding, his younger brother is Tang Lu, and he married née Zhang. He placed 5th in the Yingtian Prefectural Provincial Examination and 79th in the Metropolitan Examination.

punctuated:
袁鳳〔貫江西新淦縣人，萬全蔚州衛官籍，國子生，治《禮記》，字朝陽，行三，年四十一，三月二十二日生〕。曾祖思文〔千戶〕，祖克超〔贈千戶〕，父永宣，嫡母郭氏，生母蕭氏。慈侍下。弟忠〔千戶〕、鸞。娶郭氏。山西鄉試第二十五名，會試第一百六十九名。
田孔昭〔貫陝西鳳翔府麟遊縣民籍，縣學生，治《書經》，字德明，行二，年二十八，八月十六日生〕。曾祖榮，祖源〔兵馬司正，贈監察御史〕，父濟〔知府〕，母梁氏〔贈孺人〕，繼母關氏〔封孺人〕。具慶下。兄孔修，弟孔殷、孔碩、孔阜。娶呂氏，繼娶吳氏。陝西鄉試第二名，會試第一百五十四名。
趙琮〔貫直隸保定府清苑縣軍籍，國子生，治《詩經》，字彥玉，行四，年三十九，十月十三日生〕。曾祖士溫，祖文禮，父郁〔封刑部主事〕，母李氏〔封安人〕。嚴侍下。兄璘、瑄、璋〔按察司僉事〕。娶李氏。順天府鄉試第一百二十二名，會試第一百十七名。
劉傅〔貫直隸蘇州府嘉定縣醫籍，國子生，治《易經》，字師正，行二，年三十七，四月二十五日生〕。曾祖叔昭，祖溥，父質，嫡母華氏，生母龔氏。慈侍下。兄儔，弟侍。娶許氏，繼娶金氏。應天府鄉試第十六名，會試第一百三十五名。
translation_en:
Yuan Feng 袁鳳 (originally from Xingan County, Jiangxi, registered in an official household of the Yuzhou Guard in Wanquan; a student of the Directorate of Education specializing in the Record of Rites (Liji); courtesy name Chaoyang; third in seniority among his brothers; aged forty-one, born on the twenty-second day of the third month). His great-grandfather was Yuan Siwen (Battalion Commander), his grandfather was Yuan Kechao (posthumously honored as Battalion Commander), his father was Yuan Yongxuan, his principal mother was Lady Guo, and his birth mother is Lady Xiao. His mother is living. His younger brothers are Yuan Zhong (Battalion Commander) and Yuan Luan. He married Lady Guo. He placed twenty-fifth in the Shanxi Provincial Examination and one hundred and sixty-ninth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Tian Kongzhao 田孔昭 (registered in a civilian household of Linyou County, Fengxiang Prefecture, Shaanxi; a county student specializing in the Classic of History (Shujing); courtesy name Deming; second in seniority among his brothers; aged twenty-eight, born on the sixteenth day of the eighth month). His great-grandfather was Tian Rong, his grandfather was Tian Yuan (Commander in a Warden's Office, posthumously honored as Investigating Censor), his father is Tian Ji (Prefect), his mother was Lady Liang (posthumously honored as Child Nurturer), and his stepmother is Lady Guan (invested as Child Nurturer). Both his parents are living. His elder brother is Tian Kongxiu, and his younger brothers are Tian Kongyin, Tian Kongshuo, and Tian Kongfu. He married Lady Lü, and after her death married Lady Wu. He placed second in the Shaanxi Provincial Examination and one hundred and fifty-fourth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Zhao Cong 趙琮 (registered in a military household of Qingyuan County, Baoding Prefecture, Zhili; a student of the Directorate of Education specializing in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); courtesy name Yanyu; fourth in seniority among his brothers; aged thirty-nine, born on the thirteenth day of the tenth month). His great-grandfather was Zhao Shiwen, his grandfather was Zhao Wenli, his father is Zhao Yu (invested as Secretary in the Ministry of Justice), and his mother was Lady Li (invested as Mistress of Peace). His father is living. His elder brothers are Zhao Lin, Zhao Xuan, and Zhao Zhang (Assistant Surveillance Commissioner). He married Lady Li. He placed one hundred and twenty-second in the Shuntian Prefecture Provincial Examination and one hundred and seventeenth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Liu Fu 劉傅 (registered in a physician household of Jiading County, Suzhou Prefecture, Zhili; a student of the Directorate of Education specializing in the Classic of Changes (Yijing); courtesy name Shizheng; second in seniority among his brothers; aged thirty-seven, born on the twenty-fifth day of the fourth month). His great-grandfather was Liu Shuzhao, his grandfather was Liu Pu, his father was Liu Zhi, his principal mother was Lady Hua, and his birth mother is Lady Gong. His mother is living. His elder brother is Liu Chou, and his younger brother is Liu Shi. He married Lady Xu, and after her death married Lady Jin. He placed sixteenth in the Yingtian Prefecture Provincial Examination and one hundred and thirty-fifth in the Metropolitan Examination.

translation_en:
Guo Shen 郭紳 [native of Yichun County, Jiangxi, registered in a military household of the Yuanzhou Guard; Directorate Student; specialized in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); style name Tingzhang; first in his generation; age twenty-eight, born on the seventeenth day of the third month]. His great-grandfather was Chu Jun, his grandfather was Zigao, his father was He, and his mother was née Xie. Both of his parents are deceased. He married née Li. He placed sixty-eighth in the Jiangxi Provincial Examination and forty-fifth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Tang Xiang 唐相 [registered in a military household of She County, Huizhou Prefecture, Southern Metropolitan Area (Zhili); Directorate Student; specialized in the Spring and Autumn Annals (Chunqiu); style name Xikai; third in his generation; age thirty-two, born on the twenty-seventh day of the ninth month]. His great-grandfather was Ziyi [Princely Estabishment Secretary of Good Conduct], his grandfather was Yongji, his father was Bangda, his legal mothers were née Wang and née Pan, and his birth mother is née Bao. Both his father and mother are living. His elder brother is Zuo [Tribute Student], and his younger brothers are Bi, Jun, Ying, and Chen. He married née Wang. He placed twenty-first in the Yingtian Prefecture Provincial Examination and two hundred forty-fourth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Wu Jue 吳珏 [registered in a commoner household of Linhai County, Taizhou Prefecture, Zhejiang; Directorate Student; specialized in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); style name Mengzhang; third in his generation; age twenty-eight, born on the thirteenth day of the eighth month]. His great-grandfather was Bo'an, his grandfather was Yongfu, his father is Minlan, and his mother was née Lu. His father is living and his mother is deceased. His elder brothers are Huang and Xun, and his younger brother is Shan. He married née Zhang. He placed fourteenth in the Zhejiang Provincial Examination and three hundredth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Wang Song 王嵩 [registered in a commoner household of Ji County, Weihui Prefecture, Henan; Directorate Student; specialized in the Classic of Documents (Shujing); style name Bangzhen; fourth in his generation; age thirty-five, born on the ninth day of the first month]. His great-grandfather was De, his grandfather was Yu, his father was Xin [Assistant Prefect], and his mother is née Ma. His mother is living and his father is deceased. His elder brothers are An and Tai [Directorate Student], and his younger brother is Fu. He married née Cao. He placed twentieth in the Henan Provincial Examination and one hundred ninety-fourth in the Metropolitan Examination.

translation_en:
Wen Gui 文貴 [originally from Xiangxiang County, Huguang, registered in the Guangning Left Tun Guard in Liaodong; Guard Student (weixuesheng); specialized in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); courtesy name Tianjue; first in seniority among his brothers; aged twenty-seven, born on the fourth day of the eighth month]. His great-grandfather was Zhongbin, his grandfather was Sheng, his father was Li, and his mother was née Song. His mother is living (cishixia). He married née Wang. He ranked 31st in the Shandong Provincial Examination and 115th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Zhang Gu 張穀 [registered in a military household in Shanghai County, Songjiang Prefecture, Southern Metropolitan Area (Zhili); National University Student (guozisheng); specialized in the Classic of Changes (Yijing); courtesy name Jimin; first in seniority among his brothers; aged forty-three, born on the twenty-sixth day of the intercalary eighth month]. His great-grandfather was Shiliang [posthumously honored as Investigating Censor], his grandfather was Heng [Investigating Censor], his father was Qin, and his mother was née Yao. Both parents are deceased (yongganxia); his younger brothers are Su, Can, Ji, Shu, Jia, Xiu, and Jing; he married née Huang, and remarried née Fang. He ranked 60th in the Yingtian Prefectural Provincial Examination and 172nd in the Metropolitan Examination.

Zou Lu 鄒魯 [registered in a civilian household in Dangtu County, Taiping Prefecture, Southern Metropolitan Area (Zhili); Prefectural Student (fuxuesheng); specialized in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); courtesy name Gongfu; first in seniority among his brothers; aged twenty-six, born on the sixth day of the ninth month]. His great-grandfather was Min [National University Student], his grandfather was Shou, his father was Qian [Instructor], and his mother was née Sun. Both parents are living (juqingxia); his younger brother is Chang; he married née Zhao, and remarried née Xu. He ranked 90th in the Yingtian Prefectural Provincial Examination and 268th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Qin Fan 秦蕃 [registered in a civilian household in Changshu County, Suzhou Prefecture, Southern Metropolitan Area (Zhili); National University Student (guozisheng); specialized in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); courtesy name Lianghan; first in seniority among his brothers; aged twenty-four, born on the twenty-eighth day of the ninth month]. His great-grandfather was Junyu, his grandfather was Gongyuan, his father was Yuanmao [Public-spirited Official (yiguan)], and his mother was née Qian. Both parents are living (juqingxia); his younger brother is Sheng; he married née Zhang. He ranked 133rd in the Yingtian Prefectural Provincial Examination and 98th in the Metropolitan Examination.

translation_en:
Miao Chu 繆樗 (registered in a military household of Liyang County, Yingtian Prefecture; a County Student specializing in the Classic of Documents (Shujing); style name Quanzhi; third in seniority among his brothers; aged thirty-one, born on the eighteenth day of the fifth month). His great-grandfather was Miao Xingyuan (Administrator of the Records in a Princely Establishment); his grandfather was Miao Sui; his father was Miao Jing; his father's first wife was née Yu, and his mother was née Fei. Both of his parents are deceased. His elder brothers are Miao Chunnian and Miao Zhangnian, and his younger brother is Miao Shannian. He married née Li. He placed twenty-sixth in the Yingtian Prefectural Provincial Examination and two hundred and sixty-fourth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Xiao Qian 蕭謙 (registered in a military household of Chang'an County, Xi'an Prefecture, Shaanxi; a National University Student specializing in the Classic of Changes (Yijing); style name Ziyu; first in seniority among his brothers; aged forty-one, born on the third day of the second month). His great-grandfather was Xiao Zongli; his grandfather was Xiao Zhongxi; his father was Xiao Ju; and his mother is née Zhao. His mother is living and his father is deceased. He married née Guan, and remarried née Wu. He placed first in the Shaanxi Provincial Examination and one hundred and forty-fourth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Chen Yue 陳鉞 (registered in a military household of Liyang County, Yingtian Prefecture; a County Student specializing in the Classic of Documents (Shujing); style name Ruwei; first in seniority among his brothers; aged twenty-six, born on the twenty-eighth day of the eleventh month). His great-grandfather was Chen Neng; his grandfather is Chen Yi (Honorary Official); his father is Chen Gong (Honorary Official); and his mother is née Xu. Both his grandparents and his parents are living. His younger brothers are Chen Hao, Chen Yao, and Chen Kai. He married née Yang. He placed seventeenth in the Yingtian Prefectural Provincial Examination and one hundred and tenth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Wei Cong 魏琮 (registered in a military household of Qian'an County, Yongping Prefecture, Southern or Northern Metropolitan Area [Zhili]; a National University Student specializing in the Classic of Documents (Shujing); style name Tingyu; first in seniority among his brothers; aged forty-three, born on the fourteenth day of the seventh month). His great-grandfather was Wei Sicheng; his grandfather was Wei Yuan (Prefectural Administrative Clerk); his father was Wei Gang; and his mother was née Zhao. Both of his parents are deceased. His younger brother is Wei Lin. He married née Zhao, and remarried née Lu. He placed seventh in the Shuntian Prefectural Provincial Examination and one hundred and seventy-fourth in the Metropolitan Examination.

His great-grandfather was Wang Boyong 伯永; his grandfather was Wang Zong 宗; his father is Wang Ju 秬 [Assistant Department Magistrate]; and his mother is née Liu 劉氏. Both grandparents and parents are living. His elder brother is Wang Da 炟, and his younger brothers are Wang Yao 燿 and Wang Huan 煥. He is married to née Ding 丁氏. He placed 42nd in the Zhejiang Provincial Examination and 240th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Zhang Yulin 張玉林 [registered in a civilian household in Neijiang County, Chengdu Prefecture, Sichuan; Student in the Directorate of Education; specialized in the Classic of Documents (Shujing); style name Banghui; fifth in seniority among brothers; age forty-five; born on the second day of the ninth month]. His great-grandfather was Zhang Junxiu 均秀; his grandfather was Zhang Shuheng 淑衡; his father was Zhang Yue 鉞; and his mother is née Yuan 袁氏. His mother is living. His elder brothers are Zhang Hanlin 翰林, Zhang Cilin 詞林, Zhang Wenlin 文林, and Zhang Xiulin 秀林. He is married to née Yang 楊氏. He placed 3rd in the Sichuan Provincial Examination and 28th in the Metropolitan Examination.

His great-grandfather was Yuan Youxin 友信; his grandfather was Yuan Jiachu 甲初 [posthumously honored as Secretary in the Ministry of Revenue]; his father was Yuan Chang 常; and his mother is née He 何氏. His mother is living. His elder brothers are Yuan Yin 寅, Yuan Xuan 宣, Yuan Yi 宜 [Tribute Student / gongshi], and Yuan Shilin 士麟; his younger brother is Yuan Shilong 士龍. He is betrothed to née Li 李氏. He placed 52nd in the Guangdong Provincial Examination and 40th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Zhu Zan 朱瓚 [registered in a civilian household in Suning County, Hejian Prefecture, Zhili; Prefectural Student; specialized in the Classic of Changes (Yijing); style name Chaoyong; first in seniority among brothers; age twenty-nine; born on the twenty-second day of the eighth month]. translation_en:
He Jun 何鈞 [registered under a military household in Lingbao County, Shanzhou, Henan Prefecture, Henan; National University Student specializing in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); courtesy name Zhongheng; first in seniority among his brothers; aged thirty-five, born on the seventeenth day of the tenth month]. His great-grandfather was He Qin [Prefectural Registrar]; his grandfather was He Mao [posthumously honored as Department Magistrate]; his father is He Jun [Prefect]; and his mother is Lady Li [invested as Lady of Suitability (yiren)]. Both of his parents are living. His younger brothers are He Cong, He Luan, He Xian, He Yue, and He Ju. He married Lady Dong. He placed twenty-seventh in the Henan Provincial Examination and twenty-first in the Metropolitan Examination.

Ma Tong 馬通 [registered under a military household in the Yanshan Right Guard; Confucian scholar (rushi) specializing in the Classic of History (Shujing); courtesy name Wenda; first in seniority among his brothers; aged thirty-one, born on the eighteenth day of the eighth month]. His great-grandfather was Ma Shineng; his grandfather was Ma Fang; his father is Ma Rong; and his mother is Lady Yu. Both of his parents are living. His younger brothers are Ma Xun and Ma Jin. He married Lady Zhao. He placed fifty-fifth in the Shuntian Prefectural Provincial Examination and eighty-eighth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Zhang Jing 張璟 [registered under a civilian household in Linzhang County, Zhangde Prefecture, Henan; County Student specializing in the Classic of History (Shujing); courtesy name Tingbi; second in seniority among his brothers; aged thirty-seven, born on the eighth day of the second month]. His great-grandfather was Zhang Kuanfu; his grandfather was Zhang Zhongde; his father was Zhang Cong [Prefectural/County Instructor of Medicine]; his legal mother was Lady Li; and his birth mother is Lady Wang. His mother is living. His elder brother is Zhang Xu [Instructor of Medicine]; his younger brothers are Zhang Fan and Zhang Yu. He married Lady Han, and after her death married Lady Huang. He placed fifty-second in the Henan Provincial Examination and one hundred and twelfth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Feng Yi 馮義 [registered under a civilian household in Hancheng County, Tongzhou, Xi'an Prefecture, Shaanxi; County Student specializing in the Classic of History (Shujing); courtesy name Yizhi; second in seniority among his brothers; aged thirty-five, born on the first day of the second month]. His great-grandfather was Feng Ying; his grandfather was Feng Fuxia; his father is Feng Kang [Instructor]; his mother was Lady Zhang; and his stepmother was Lady Zhang. His father is living. His elder brother is Feng Mei; his younger brother is Feng Gao. He married Lady Wang. He placed twenty-fifth in the Shaanxi Provincial Examination and one hundred and fifth in the Metropolitan Examination.

劉愷〔貫直隸滁州軍籍，國子生，治《易經》，字伯和，行二，年三十四，二月初五日生〕。曾祖均義；祖仕達〔贈給事中〕；父守道；嫡母何氏，生母高氏。慈侍下。兄恒；弟悅。娶陳氏。應天府鄉試第三十三名，會試第二百五十二名。

translation_en:
Liu Kai 劉愷 (registered in a military household in Chuzhou 滁州, Southern Metropolitan Area [Zhili 直隸]; a National University Student specializing in the Classic of Changes [Yijing]; courtesy name Bohe 伯和; second in seniority among his brothers; aged thirty-four sui, born on the fifth day of the second month). His great-grandfather was Liu Junyi 劉均義; his grandfather was Liu Shida 劉仕達 (posthumously honoured as Supervising Secretary); his father was Liu Shoudao 劉守道; his legal mother was née He 何, and his birth mother is née Gao 高. His mother is living. He has an elder brother, Liu Heng 劉恒, and a younger brother, Liu Yue 劉悅. He is married to née Chen 陳. He placed thirty-third in the Yingtian Prefectural 應天府 Provincial Examination and two hundred fifty-second in the Metropolitan Examination.

Zhang Guan 張貫 (registered in an artisan household in Lixian 蠡縣, Baoding Prefecture 保定府, Northern Metropolitan Area [Zhili 直隸]; an Added Student of the county school specializing in the Classic of Poetry [Shijing]; courtesy name Yizhi 一之; second in seniority among his brothers; aged twenty-seven sui, born on the twenty-sixth day of the first month). His great-grandfather was Zhang Shineng 張士能; his grandfather was Zhang Qing 張清; his father is Zhang You 張友; his mother is née Wang 王. Both of his parents are living. He has an elder brother, Zhang Yue 張恱, and a younger brother, Zhang Yu 張愉. He is married to née Feng 馮. He placed forty-third in the Shuntian Prefectural 順天府 Provincial Examination and two hundred eighteenth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Zhang Bin 張賓 (registered in a military household in Shan County 單縣, Yanzhou Prefecture 兖州府, Shandong 山東; a National University Student specializing in the Classic of Documents [Shujing]; courtesy name Tingshi 廷實; first in seniority among his brothers; aged thirty-seven sui, born on the first day of the tenth month). His great-grandfather was Zhang Zongdao 張宗道; his grandfather was Zhang Su 張肅; his father is Zhang Gong 張拱; his mother was née Tang 唐, and his stepmother is née Deng 鄧. Both his father and stepmother are living. He has younger brothers, Zhang Song 張崧, Zhang Jiang 張勥, Zhang Yu 張宇, and Zhang Yun 張允. He is married to née Si 司. He placed forty-ninth in the Shandong Provincial Examination and sixty-sixth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Zhang Ximing 張西銘 (registered in a civilian household in Ningzhou 寧州, Lin'an Prefecture 臨安府, Yunnan 雲南; a subprefectural school student specializing in the Classic of Documents [Shujing]; courtesy name Xizai 希載; fifth in seniority among his brothers; aged thirty-two sui, born on the sixth day of the eleventh month). His great-grandfather was Zhang Yi 張益; his grandfather was Zhang Yao 張瑤 (posthumously honoured as Investigating Censor); his father was Zhang Hai 張海 (Surveillance Commissioner); his legal mother was née Yang 楊 (posthumously honoured as Child Nurturer), and his birth mother is née Guan 官. His mother is living. He has elder brothers, Zhang Zhuo 張晫, Zhang Shu 張曙, Zhang Shi 張時, and Zhang Bao 張曓, and a younger brother, Zhang Chao 張晁. He is married to née Sun 孫. He placed third in the Yunnan Provincial Examination and one hundred twenty-third in the Metropolitan Examination.

王宬〔貫廣東潮州府海陽縣，民籍，國子生，治《春秋》，字容之，行三，年三十六，十一月十四日生〕。曾祖子端，祖永紹，父益〔學正，改陰陽訓術〕，母鄭氏。慈侍下。兄賓、實，弟宴、寅、容、寬。娶陳氏。廣東鄉試第六十名，會試第四十一名。

金章〔貫直隸崑山縣人，雲南雲南中衛軍籍，雲南府學生，治《詩經》，字相用，行一，年三十，十二月二十一日生〕。曾祖永昌，祖通，父鋃，母丁氏。具慶下。弟冕、昺、昆。娶朱氏。雲南鄉試第十六名，會試第一百八十名。

translation_en:
Wang Cheng 王宬 (native of Haiyang County 海陽縣, Chaozhou Prefecture 潮州府, Guangdong; registered in a civilian household; National University Student [guozisheng]; specialized in the Spring and Autumn Annals [Chunqiu]; style name Rongzhi 容之; third in seniority among brothers; age thirty-six, born on the fourteenth day of the eleventh month). His great-grandfather was Wang Ziduan 王子端; his grandfather was Wang Yongshao 王永紹; his father was Wang Yi 王益 (Subprefectural Director of Studies [xuezheng], reassigned as Instructor of a Geomancy and Divination School [yinyang xunshu]); and his mother is née Zheng 鄭. His mother is living. His elder brothers are Wang Bin 王賓 and Wang Shi 王實; his younger brothers are Wang Yan 王宴, Wang Yin 王寅, Wang Rong 王容, and Wang Kuan 王寬. He is married to née Chen 陳. He placed sixtieth in the Guangdong Provincial Examination and forty-first in the Metropolitan Examination.

Jin Zhang 金章 (originally from Kunshan County 崑山縣, Southern Metropolitan Area [Zhili]; registered in a military household of the Yunnan Guard Central 雲南中衛, Yunnan; Prefectural Student [fuxuesheng] of Yunnan Prefecture 雲南府; specialized in the Classic of Poetry [Shijing]; style name Xiangyong 相用; first in seniority among brothers; age thirty, born on the twenty-first day of the twelfth month). His great-grandfather was Jin Yongchang 金永昌; his grandfather was Jin Tong 金通; his father is Jin Lang 金鋃; and his mother is née Ding 丁. Both of his parents are living. His younger brothers are Jin Mian 金冕, Jin Bing 金昺, and Jin Kun 金昆. He is married to née Zhu 朱. He placed sixteenth in the Yunnan Provincial Examination and one hundred and eightieth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Hu Qi 胡棨 (native of Chun'an County 淳安縣, Yanzhou Prefecture 嚴州府, Zhejiang; registered in a military household; National University Student [guozisheng]; specialized in the Spring and Autumn Annals [Chunqiu]; style name Xinzhi 信之; first in seniority among brothers; age twenty-seven, born on the twenty-ninth day of the fifth month). His great-grandfather was Hu Zhentong 胡真同; his grandfather was Hu Mengshuo 胡夢說; his father is Hu Wenrui 胡文瑞; and his mother is née Fang 方. Both of his parents are living. His younger brothers are Hu Zhe 胡哲, Hu Ji 胡吉, Hu Lü 胡吕, Hu Hao 胡號, Hu Pin 胡品, Hu Qi 胡器, Hu Xiao 胡斅, and Hu Bi 胡弼. He is married to née Fang 方. He placed thirty-fourth in the Zhejiang Provincial Examination and one hundred and seventh in the Metropolitan Examination.

Li Shangda 李尚達 (native of Min County 閩縣, Fuzhou Prefecture 福州府, Fujian; registered in a civilian household; Confucian Scholar [rushi]; specialized in the Classic of Poetry [Shijing]; style name Shangda 尚達; fourth in seniority among brothers; age thirty-eight, born on the twenty-first day of the twelfth month). His great-grandfather was Li Gang 李剛; his grandfather was Li An 李安; his father was Li Fu 李福; his legal mother was née Peng 彭; and his birth mother was née Yao 姚. Both of his parents are deceased. His elder brothers are Li Dehui 李德輝 and Li Wenhui 李文輝. He is married to née Cheng 程. He placed thirty-fifth in the Fujian Provincial Examination and two hundred and forty-ninth in the Metropolitan Examination.
